jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, España
jobs.description:
El idioma de trabajo en Lasting Dynamics es el inglés. Por eso el resto de esta oferta está redactado en inglés: si puedes leerla con comodidad, eres el perfil que buscamos.
Full Stack Engineer with AI — On-site in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
Imagine writing code ten minutes from the ocean, in a city with mild weather all year round and a lower cost of living than most major European tech hubs.
We're hiring a Full Stack Engineer to join our team on-site in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria. If you're based in mainland Spain or elsewhere in the EU and open to relocating to the Canary Islands, we support you through the whole process — housing, NIE, empadronamiento and a dedicated contact during onboarding.
About Lasting Dynamics
We're an independent software company, founded in 2015 and built without external investment. We grow through long-term partnerships, not high-volume delivery — many clients come to us after unsuccessful outsourcing experiences and stay for years. We build complex web and mobile products for international clients, with a strong focus on quality, accountability and solid engineering standards. We're now scaling the team and integrating AI more deeply into how we work.
The role
You'll work across frontend and backend through the full lifecycle: from understanding product requirements and discussing architecture, to building features, reviewing code, improving performance and maintaining production-quality applications. Our stack is modern — React, Node.js, TypeScript and cloud-based environments.
It's a fit for someone with 3+ years of experience who wants to move beyond pure execution, take on more ownership and grow as an engineer in a team that takes quality seriously.
How we use AI
AI is already part of how we build. You'll use Claude and GitHub Copilot — both provided by the company — for coding, refactoring, debugging, documentation, test generation and technical exploration, and we're exploring agent-based workflows for repetitive tasks. The principle: engineers stay directly responsible for the code they ship. AI raises productivity and quality, it doesn't lower the bar.
What you'll do
Develop and maintain production-ready web applications, frontend and backend, for international client projects
Take part in technical discussions, architecture decisions and system design
Write clean, testable, maintainable code and review for quality and clarity
Collaborate with designers, product owners and other engineers
Help improve our workflow, engineering standards and internal processes
Must-have
3+ years building web applications across frontend and backend
Solid modern JavaScript/TypeScript; React, Node.js or similar
Good grasp of clean code, testing and maintainability
Comfortable using AI coding tools (Copilot, Claude or similar)
Drive to take ownership and grow over time
Good professional English — our working language for meetings, code and documentation
Valid right to work in Spain or the EU (or clear eligibility to obtain it)
Nice-to-have
System design basics and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure)
Experience on international client projects
Interest in AI, LLMs, automation or autonomous agents
What we offer
€32,000–€48,000 gross/year, based on experience, autonomy and fit
Full-time, on-site role in Las Palmas with a long-term perspective
The stability of a bootstrapped company (founded 2015, no external investors, no layoff cycles)
Real production projects for international clients — not internal demos
Company-provided AI tools: Claude and GitHub Copilot
A structured engineering culture with room to grow into ownership and architecture
End-to-end relocation support: housing, NIE, empadronamiento, a dedicated onboarding contact
Life in the Canary Islands: ocean, year-round mild climate, an international environment and an affordable cost of living

jobs.title: Desarrollador de Software Embebido

jobs.title: Ingeniero/a FPGA (Sector Aeroespacial / Defensa)
jobs.description:
¿Te apasiona el desarrollo de software embebido y buscas un nuevo reto profesional? ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

En ARGHOS (Grupo AERNNOVA), estamos en búsqueda de Ingenieros/as de Software Embebido C/C++, tanto Juniors como Seniors, para incorporarse a un equipo dinámico y trabajar en proyectos de vanguardia en sectores como Defensa / Espacio / Transporte / Renovables, etc.

Modalidad: Teletrabajo híbrido - 3 días en oficina.

Ubicación: Madrid (Disponibilidad para acudir a la oficina 3 días a la semana).



Responsabilidades:

Desarrollo de software embebido en C y C++ para sistemas críticos y de alto rendimiento.

Diseño, implementación y pruebas de firmware en plataformas embebidas.

Integración con hardware, sensores y protocolos de comunicación.

Optimización de código y depuración en entornos de sistemas en tiempo real (RTOS).

Participación en revisiones de código y mejoras en arquitectura de software.



Requisitos:

Conocimientos en programación en C/C++ y sistemas embebidos.
Familiaridad con microcontroladores y arquitecturas ARM, PIC, STM32, etc.
Conocimientos en protocolos de comunicación (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, etc.).
Dominio de C/C++ y arquitecturas de sistemas embebidos.
Experiencia con RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, etc.) y depuración de código en hardware real.
Experiencia en integración de hardware/software, optimización de rendimiento y testing en plataformas embebidas.
Valorable experiencia en sistemas de seguridad funcional y estándares como ISO 26262, DO-178C, IEC *texto oculto*88; Ofrecemos:

Salario competitivo según experiencia.

Modalidad híbrida (3 días en oficina y 2 en teletrabajo).

Oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos punteros en tecnología embebida.

Plan de carrera adaptado a cada perfil.



¿Te interesa? Aplica ahora o comparte con alguien que pueda estar interesado/a. ¡Nos encantará conocerte!




¿Quiénes somos?
ARGHOS es una empresa de Servicios de Ingeniería presente en diferentes sectores industriales como el Aeroespacial y Defensa, Transporte (Ferrocarril & Automoción), Plantas Industriales y Energía.
Estamos involucrados en proyectos de Ingeniería y Tecnología de vanguardia en actividades de: Mecánica (Diseño, Cálculo y Utillaje), Sistemas (Diseño/Desarrollo Software, Hardware, Firmware y pruebas de integración) y Procesos (RAMS/ILS, Calidad y Configuración de Producto) desde la fase de diseño conceptual hasta la industrialización final de Productos.
ARGHOS es una división de Ingeniería del Grupo AERNNOVA, empresa global de aeroestructuras, líder en sus sectores de actividad y con gran proyección internacional.

ARGHOS apuesta por la igualdad de oportunidades entre todas las personas como pilar fundamental del desarrollo profesional y personal. Por ello, damos la bienvenida a todas las candidaturas sin distinción de raza, sexo, estado civil, ideología, nacionalidad, religión o cualquier condición personal, física o social.
Beneficios sociales: 
- Flexibilidad horaria
- Teletrabajo
Especialidad: 
- No requerido

jobs.title: Senior Graphic Designer
jobs.description:
Are you a talented Senior Designer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers & designers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Communicate directly with the clients. Sounds good, yeah?
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.

 

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Graphic Design
  • 5+ years of commercial experience with Adobe Creative Suite & Adobe Illustrator

 

Other requirements:

  • Strong design craft — as a Senior Designer, you're expected to build polished, production-ready work from scratch, with a solid grasp of design systems, component architecture, and how your decisions translate into real product or brand outcomes.
  • Clear and confident communication in English — advanced ability to discuss creative briefs, defend design decisions, and flag blockers early. Strong self-presentation is essential, particularly on client calls.
  • High ownership, zero hand-holding — you thrive working full-time remotely, manage your own time, and consistently hit deadlines without being chased.
  • Reliability — we need to trust you completely. If you commit to something, you deliver it. If something changes, you communicate early.
  • Fast ramp-up — you can absorb project context quickly, align with existing style guides or brand directions, and start producing valuable work within the first days, not weeks.

 

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We have a variety of projects, so if you have 4+ years of commercial software development experience and are proficient in AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Dart, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & Angular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Data Annotation, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering, we would be happy to connect with you and match you with a project that fits your experience.
jobs.tailored_advice: Since this is a marketplace for startups, emphasize your ability to work autonomously and deliver production-ready assets quickly. Highlight specific projects where you managed the full design lifecycle, from brief to final delivery. Since they value 'zero hand-holding,' include a section on your portfolio that explains your design process and how you handle client feedback. Ensure your English proficiency is evident in your CV, as they explicitly require confident communication for client-facing roles. Finally, showcase your expertise in design systems and component architecture to prove you can scale work effectively.

While my core expertise lies in software development, I have consistently applied Adobe Creative Suite and Adobe Illustrator to bridge the gap between functional code and polished, user-centric interfaces in my projects, such as the Catering SanMor corporate website. My experience building full-stack applications from scratch has trained me to approach design with a developer’s mindset—focusing on component architecture, scalability, and clean execution. I am comfortable managing complex project requirements independently and communicating effectively in English, ensuring that design decisions are not just aesthetic, but strategically aligned with product goals.

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing engineering team and help design, develop, and deliver innovative digital solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for building scalable, cloud-native applications, integrating AI capabilities, and driving technical excellence across the software development lifecycle.
As a senior engineer, you will collaborate with architects, product owners, data scientists, and cross-functional teams to create high-quality solutions that solve complex business challenges.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and integrate Generative AI capabilities into enterprise-grade solutions.
Build and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, microservices, and integrations.
Develop data ingestion, processing, transformation, and orchestration pipelines for structured and unstructured data.
Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions leveraging corporate knowledge bases, repositories, and enterprise systems.
Work with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search engines, and agent frameworks.
Design prompts, tools, workflows, AI agents, and structured output mechanisms.
Integrate AI solutions with internal platforms, third-party services, enterprise applications, and legacy systems.
Leverage modern development tools, including AI-assisted coding platforms, to accelerate software delivery.
Develop automation solutions using APIs, scripting languages, workflows, Infrastructure as Code, and orchestration platforms.
Ensure software quality through best practices in testing, code reviews, observability, and performance optimization.
Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to technology decisions and standards.
Mentor junior engineers and promote engineering excellence across the team.
Collaborate in Agile environments, participating in sprint planning, estimations, retrospectives, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in software engineering and backend development.
Strong programming skills in one or more of the following languages: Java, Python, C#, Go, TypeScript, or Node.js.
Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures.
Solid understanding of software design patterns, clean code principles, and application architecture.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience working with container technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
Knowledge of CI/CD practices and DevOps methodologies.
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with Git-based development workflows and collaborative software engineering practices.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken).
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Generative AI technologies and modern AI application development.
Knowledge of frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen.
Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Chroma, or Azure AI Search.
Understanding of Machine Learning, MLOps, and AI model deployment.
Experience implementing RAG architectures and AI-powered enterprise solutions.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or Bicep.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry.
Exposure to cybersecurity, data privacy, and responsible AI principles.
Relevant cloud certifications (Azure, AWS, GCP) are a plus
jobs.tailored_advice: Para destacar en esta posición de Senior AI Software Engineer, tu CV debe enfatizar proyectos donde hayas implementado RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) y trabajado con LLMs. No listes solo lenguajes; detalla cómo has integrado frameworks como LangChain o LlamaIndex en arquitecturas escalables. Dado que piden experiencia en AWS y microservicios, resalta tu capacidad para desplegar soluciones de IA en entornos cloud utilizando contenedores (Docker/Kubernetes). Si tienes experiencia con bases de datos vectoriales (Pinecone, Chroma), asegúrate de que aparezcan en la parte superior de tu perfil técnico, ya que son diferenciadores clave para este rol.
jobs.cover_letter: Como desarrollador apasionado por la integración de inteligencia artificial en soluciones reales, he seguido de cerca su trabajo en el desarrollo de aplicaciones escalables. Mi experiencia construyendo proyectos propios, como una plataforma de comercio electrónico con asistentes virtuales basados en IA, me ha permitido dominar el ciclo de vida completo del software, desde la lógica backend hasta la implementación de modelos de lenguaje. Aunque mi trayectoria es joven, mi capacidad de aprendizaje autodidacta y mi dominio de Java y Python me permiten abordar retos técnicos complejos con la misma agilidad que requiere su equipo. He desarrollado herramientas de automatización y aplicaciones de escritorio que demuestran mi enfoque en la calidad y la eficiencia. Entiendo perfectamente la importancia de crear arquitecturas robustas y escalables, y estoy muy motivado por la posibilidad de aplicar mis conocimientos en el desarrollo de soluciones RAG y agentes inteligentes dentro de un entorno profesional de alto nivel. Me entusiasma la oportunidad de aportar mi proactividad y mis habilidades técnicas a su equipo de ingeniería. Estoy a su entera disposición para concertar una entrevista y profundizar en cómo mi perfil puede contribuir a sus objetivos actuales.

Enfocado en la creación de soluciones escalables, automatización y mejora de procesos, con nivel de inglés C1 y gran capacidad de adaptación técnica.

jobs.title: Sales Jedi
jobs.description:
Great salary | Profit share | 100% remote |
Work from anywhere in Europe | SaaS

 

Awesome opportunity for a self-motivated and energetic people person to join our remote team and help sell our world-leading SaaS products, from anywhere in Europe.

We pay a great salary, based on experience and location. We don’t pay commissions, because good sales are a team effort—from engineering, to operations, marketing, and support, our high-performing team all contribute to a great product and service that our clients love. Everybody in the company is rewarded with a share of profit each December—we succeed together.

Our much-loved products are in demand and are proven to make a difference to our clients’ lives. You’ll be selling world-leading software through a well-considered process that leaves room for personal flair.

 

SaaS experience is extremely beneficial but strong communication skills, patience, curiosity, keenness to learn and friendliness are key to success in this role.

Join our Rebel Alliance

Creative Force is experiencing strong growth and as we scale our efforts in 2026 and beyond, we’re looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our diverse team of Jedis to help recruit new clients as they navigate the decision process, and transform them into long-term supporters.

You’ll be a respected member of our remote global sales team and will be well supported with the tools, knowledge and answers you need to provide exceptional levels of service, and to make the most from solid sales traction with our two in-demand products.

As you master the Force and the multitude of skills needed in this role, attracting clients to join our mission, you will be recognised and rewarded with strong career and salary progression.

Responsibilities

 

  • Help prospects find the specific value they seek (this is the product you are looking for)
  • Collaborate with our diverse international team to push us on the leading edge of our fields
  • Learn to be a product expert and confidently answer product questions from prospects
  • Discover how to be an expert in SaaS for recognition programs
  • Master our sales technology stack
  • Support the complete sales cycle, from qualified lead to close
  • Skillfully navigate consultative sales discussions and live demos

Essentials

 

  • Applications are open to all experience levels, with a minimum of 1 year proven success in SaaS sales or a similar role
  • Must live in Europe
  • Digital native, with enthusiasm for technology
  • Discipline and self-motivation (key to success in remote work)
  • Loads of energy, humour, passion, and empathy
  • Genuine interest to help provide amazing value for people
  • Superior communication skills
  • Commitment to continuous improvement
  • You have access to fast, reliable internet and a dedicated space to work without distractions
  • Meet and exceed measurable performance goals to succeed and progress in this role

What we offer

Work-life balance

  • 38 hour work week, Monday to Friday (your weekends are yours)
  • 20 days paid annual leave
  • 20 days paid parental leave (available after one year)
  • 12 days paid public holidays (your local country/region public holidays)
  • Your birthday is a holiday every year

Personal development and wellbeing

  • Commitment to continued learning and development
  • A culture of promoting work life balance
  • Access to mental health support

Location and compensation

  • Full-time role, based remotely, work anywhere within Europe
  • No commission structure. Competitive salary, indexed to your experience and location
  • Budget for computer and office equipment (pending 6 month probationary period)

 

Respect, growth and stability

  • Friendly, sociable, responsible, collaborative team (a great place to be)
  • Respect for each other’s time, value and contribution
  • Regular communication with global team via chat and video calls
  • Dynamic, young, growing tech company leveraging all the latest tech tools and leading industry trends
  • Stable, bootstrapped, independent business (no VCs calling the shots)

jobs.title: SaaS Product Support Jedi
jobs.location: Europe, EMEA, UK, Germany, France, European timezones
jobs.description:
We’re on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven SaaS pro who’s as comfortable troubleshooting API and integrations as they are navigating human conversations.

Our European client base is growing fast and we need someone who can keep up. Our software isn’t your average plug-and-play; it has a steep learning curve so you’ll need to be technically savvy while also being the kind of person clients genuinely enjoy talking to. If you’ve got SaaS in your DNA, thrive in async/remote environments, and can juggle multiple threads without breaking a sweat — keep reading.

The role

You’ll join a lean, high-performing global support team working across two SaaS products, Award Force and Good Grants. Day to day you’ll be communicating with colleagues and clients across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Support happens across email tickets, phone, and 1-1 Zoom calls. Once you’ve leveled up on product knowledge, you’ll run onboarding sessions and client meetings covering issue resolution, best practices, and product adoption.

You’ll also be hands-on with bug testing and reporting, feeding considered feedback to our product teams— always pushing to make our products better.

We have a startup mindset. We experiment with new tools, iterate on processes, and move fast. Got a great idea? Pitch it. We’re not big on bureaucracy, only results. We don’t expect you to be a slave to your chair but flexibility is a must.

You’ll need to tick these boxes
  • You’re based in the UTC +1 or +2 timezone range. This is non-negotiable. Our European team and clients operate in this window and we don’t allow shift work. If you live outside this range, this one’s not for you
  • 2+ years of professional experience, ideally in a SaaS support or client-facing role
  • Native-level English fluency (bilingual? Even better!)
  • Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, dev console, staging & production environments, GitHub repos, and database queries don’t make you flinch. You don’t need to write code, but you need to get it
  • You’ve got exceptional interpersonal and communication skills—written and verbal
  • Client calls energise you. Four to five Zoom meetings a day? Bring it on
  • You’re a natural problem solver who loves helping others untangle theirs
  • Your writing is clean, well-structured, and detail-oriented
  • You’re curious by nature and love learning new things
  • You’re not allergic to upselling or fielding “sales-y” questions
  • You’re organised and process-driven. Multiple tools for different workflows? No problem — you thrive in that setup
  • You’re self-motivated and independent, but you also value being part of a tight-knit team
  • Remote work isn’t just something you dabble in—it’s where you do your best work. You’ve got fast, reliable internet and a distraction-free workspace ready to go

 

Responsibilities

Product support

  • Go deep on product knowledge through self-driven learning—become the expert

  • Be the first point of contact on all inbound support via email/tickets, phone, and eventually live chat

  • Run 1-1 Zoom sessions with clients for technical consultation and query resolution

  • Maintain our consistently impressive first-reply-time metric (yeah, we’re proud of it)

  • Provide technically accurate responses backed by hands-on testing of scenarios

  • Collaborate with engineering to squash bugs and keep clients in the loop with timely updates

  • Spot patterns in user issues and flag them for product improvement

 

Be seriously good with clients

  • Speed matters. Respond quickly and decisively
  • Listen deeply—get to the root of the issue and own it until it’s resolved
  • Treat every client interaction with genuine respect and appreciation
  • Build trusting, long-term relationships rooted in honesty and transparency

En 2026, hemos sido reconocidos en la Lista Forbes como una de las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar en España, destacando por nuestra flexibilidad y personalización en la experiencia del empleado. ¿Nos acompañas en esta aventura? #FutureTogether

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos un(a) Software Developer Backend (Camunda) con al menos 4 años de experiencia en posiciones similares para incorporarse a un proyecto estable y de larga duración en cliente del sector digital. 

 ¿Cuáles son los requisitos?
 Experiencia práctica en el diseño e implementación de procesos BPMN de Camunda 8.
 Profundo conocimiento de Java (11 o superior) y Java Spring (4 o superior) y sólida comprensión de los principios de OO.
 Experiencia en el diseño y construcción de arquitecturas orientadas a servicios o microservicios.
 Diligente con las pruebas automatizadas, es decir, JUnit/Mockito/Cucumber, etc.
Experiencia sólida con herramientas de integración y entrega continua.
 Metodologías ágiles (SCRUM) y ciclo de vida del software.
 Comprensión de los principios de API RESTful.
Dominio del inglés hablado y escrito (mínimo C1).
 ¿Cómo será tu día a día?
Diseñar procesos en BPMN, implementarlos en Camunda 8 y desarrollar la lógica necesaria en Java + Spring Boot para automatizar tareas y flujos de negocio.
Crear y mantener microservicios Java, APIs REST y las integraciones entre diferentes sistemas, aplicando buenas prácticas de arquitectura, programación orientada a objetos y diseño de servicios.
Crear pruebas automatizadas con JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber, trabajar con pipelines de CI/CD y, según el entorno, utilizar Docker y Kubernetes para desplegar y gestionar los servicios.
Participar en Daily, Planning, Refinements, Reviews y Retrospectives, gestionar tareas en JIRA, documentar en Confluence, analizar incidencias y colaborar con otros desarrolladores, arquitectos y equipos de negocio.

¿Conoce nuestra propuesta de valor
 Contrato indefinido.
Modelo híbrido: Súmate a nuestro modelo Softtek 56, que se adapta a las circunstancias de cada Softtekian y en donde podrás conectar y desarrollarte con nuestros equipos en las diferentes sedes 56 horas al mes y disfruta de teletrabajo el resto del tiempo.
 Conciliación: Horario flexible y el programa BetterWork que apoya el equilibrio entre tu vida personal y profesional.
¿¿24 días de vacaciones
 Seguro médico
 Retribución flexible: tarjeta transporte, tarjeta restaurante, cheque guardería o seguro médico familiares.
 Tarde de cumpleaños libre (también por el cumple de tus hijos)
 Club del empleado: Beneficios y promociones exclusivas por ser Softtekian.
 Planes de formación: idiomas, tecnologías y habilidades interpersonales.
 Oportunidad de movilidad interna: en nuestras sedes internacionales y dentro de España.
 Valoraremos especialmente la candidatura de personas que posean habilidades y capacidades únicas y diversas, reconociendo la importancia de facilitar su integración plena en el mercado laboral. Cada individuo, con sus capacidades singulares, aporta una riqueza invaluable a nuestra comunidad, y nuestro compromiso es asegurar que todos tengan la oportunidad de demostrar su valía y contribuir al crecimiento y la diversidad de nuestro equipo.
 ¡Estamos deseando conocerte!

jobs.title: Desarrollador/a de Software - Teruel
jobs.description:
En Infoter buscamos Desarrollador/a de Software

¿Te gusta programar, resolver problemas y ver cómo lo que desarrollas acaba utilizándose en el día a día de una empresa?
En Infoter seguimos creciendo y queremos incorporar un/a Desarrollador/a de Software a nuestro equipo en Teruel, en modalidad híbrida, aunque también podemos valorar perfiles en teletrabajo 100%.
Buscamos una persona que quiera combinar desarrollo de aplicaciones, implantación de producto propio y contacto con empresas, participando en soluciones tecnológicas que evolucionan según las necesidades reales de nuestros clientes.
Somos una empresa tecnológica de Teruel con casi 25 años de experiencia y un equipo de alrededor de 30 profesionales. Desarrollamos, implantamos y damos soporte a soluciones empresariales, además de crear aplicaciones a medida.


¿Qué harás en tu día a día?
Tu trabajo combinará desarrollo, implantación y soporte de soluciones empresariales. No trabajarás siempre sobre el mismo tipo de aplicación, sino que participarás en proyectos relacionados con diferentes procesos:
ERP, CRM, GMAO y SGA: implantación, soporte y evolución de sistemas de gestión empresarial. 
Control de presencia, registro horario y accesos: configuración, puesta en marcha, soporte y evolución. 
Facturación, TPV y gestión de flotas: implantación y soporte de soluciones utilizadas en la operativa diaria. 
Desarrollo de aplicaciones a medida según las necesidades de cada cliente. 
 Desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades e integraciones con otros sistemas. 
 Pruebas, implantación, soporte y evolución posterior de las soluciones. 

Es un puesto especialmente interesante si, además de programar, te gusta entender el negocio que hay detrás del software y convertir necesidades reales en soluciones tecnológicas.


¿Qué buscamos?
Como requisitos mínimos:
Técnico Superior en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Multiplataforma (DAM), titulación superior relacionada con el desarrollo de software o equivalente. 
Carnet de conducir.
La experiencia profesional será valorada, pero no es imprescindible si tienes una buena base técnica, actitud y capacidad de aprendizaje.

Además, buscamos una persona que disfrute programando y resolviendo problemas, tenga capacidad de análisis, curiosidad técnica e iniciativa. Valoramos especialmente la capacidad para trabajar en equipo, entender las necesidades de los usuarios, tratar con clientes y querer desarrollar una carrera profesional a largo plazo.


No necesitas llegar sabiéndolo todo
Si ya tienes experiencia, queremos que puedas aportar tus conocimientos y seguir evolucionando. Si estás comenzando tu carrera después de DAM y tienes una buena base, actitud y ganas de aprender, también queremos conocerte.
Tendrás formación, acompañamiento y oportunidades reales de crecimiento y especialización.


¿Qué ofrecemos?
Contrato indefinido.
 Jornada continua habitual de 7:00 a 15:00 h.
 Horario de verano de 8:00 a 15:00 h.
24 días de vacaciones al año.
Modalidad híbrida, con posibilidad de valorar teletrabajo 100% según el perfil. 
Salario entre 20.000 y 29.000 € brutos/año, según experiencia, conocimientos y perfil profesional. 
Retribución variable adicional muy interesante.
 Plan de carrera y desarrollo profesional. 
 Certificaciones oficiales y formación adaptada a tu perfil y evolución. 
 Formación y especialización en Inteligencia Artificial aplicada al desarrollo, al producto y a nuevos proyectos. 
 Trabajo con producto propio, implantaciones reales y desarrollos a medida para empresas. 
 Estabilidad y posibilidades de crecimiento dentro de una empresa tecnológica consolidada. 


Un puesto para ver crecer lo que desarrollas
Aquí no trabajarás únicamente sobre código aislado. Podrás participar en una solución desde que surge una necesidad hasta que se desarrolla, se implanta en una empresa, comienza a utilizarse y continúa evolucionando.


 Envía tu candidatura

Dado que la oferta menciona ERP, CRM, GMAO y SGA, resalta cualquier proyecto previo donde hayas interactuado con bases de datos complejas o sistemas de gestión. Como desarrollador en formación y apasionado por la creación de software, me motiva enormemente la posibilidad de aplicar mis conocimientos en ERP, CRM y sistemas de gestión, áreas que considero fundamentales para entender el impacto real de la tecnología en el tejido empresarial. En mis proyectos personales, como mi plataforma de comercio electrónico con IA integrada, he aprendido a gestionar bases de datos, automatizar procesos y resolver problemas complejos de forma autónoma, habilidades que estoy deseando trasladar a vuestros sistemas de gestión y aplicaciones a medida. Mi perfil combina una sólida base técnica con una gran capacidad de aprendizaje y adaptación, cualidades que encajan con la filosofía de crecimiento y formación continua que promueve Infoter. Me entusiasma la idea de aportar mi experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones multiplataforma y mi curiosidad por la Inteligencia Artificial para contribuir a la evolución de vuestros productos. En 2026, hemos sido reconocidos en la Lista Forbes como una de las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar en España, destacando por nuestra flexibilidad y personalización en la experiencia del empleado. ¿Nos acompañas en esta aventura? #FutureTogether

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos un(a) Software Engineer Fullstack (Angular+Java) con mínimo 8 años de experiencia en posiciones similares para incorporarse a un proyecto estable y de larga duración en cliente del sector de banking. 

 ¿Cuáles son los requisitos?
Experiencia sólida (8 o más años) en desarrollo frontend con Angular.
Experiencia implementando funcionalidades de datos en tiempo real (por ejemplo, ag-Grid).
Experiencia práctica como desarrollador Java, especialmente con microservicios (Spring Boot o frameworks similares).
Dominio de TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 y CSS3.
Experiencia integrando APIs REST y trabajando con datos en JSON.
Experiencia utilizando Inteligencia Artificial para diseño de interfaces (UX), creación de plantillas, refactorización de código y eliminación de vulnerabilidades.
Conocimientos de diseño responsive y principios de diseño adaptativo.
Experiencia utilizando sistemas de control de versiones (Git).
Experiencia con librerías de gestión de estado como NgRx o Akita.
Conocimientos de tecnologías de contenedorización como Docker y Kubernetes.
Experiencia con librerías de visualización de datos como D3.js o Chart.js.
Nivel de inglés B2.
Nivel de español B2.

 ¿Cómo será tu día a día?
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones web utilizando Angular (últimas versiones). Será necesario realizar la actualización de versiones.
Implementar funcionalidades de datos en tiempo real utilizando tecnologías como ag-Grid o similares.
Colaborar con los equipos de backend y contribuir al desarrollo e integración de APIs y microservicios basados en Java.
Garantizar una comunicación fluida entre el frontend y los servicios backend mediante APIs REST, JSON, etc.
Optimizar el rendimiento de las aplicaciones para mejorar la velocidad y la escalabilidad, especialmente en escenarios con un uso intensivo de datos.
Escribir código limpio, mantenible y bien documentado siguiendo las mejores prácticas de desarrollo.

¿Conoce nuestra propuesta de valor
 Contrato indefinido.
Modelo híbrido: Súmate a nuestro modelo Softtek 56, que se adapta a las circunstancias de cada Softtekian y en donde podrás conectar y desarrollarte con nuestros equipos en las diferentes sedes 56 horas al mes y disfruta de teletrabajo el resto del tiempo.
 Conciliación: Horario flexible y el programa BetterWork que apoya el equilibrio entre tu vida personal y profesional.
¿¿24 días de vacaciones
 Seguro médico
 Retribución flexible: tarjeta transporte, tarjeta restaurante, cheque guardería o seguro médico familiares.
 Tarde de cumpleaños libre (también por el cumple de tus hijos)
 Club del empleado: Beneficios y promociones exclusivas por ser Softtekian.
 Planes de formación: idiomas, tecnologías y habilidades interpersonales.
 Oportunidad de movilidad interna: en nuestras sedes internacionales y dentro de España.
 Valoraremos especialmente la candidatura de personas que posean habilidades y capacidades únicas y diversas, reconociendo la importancia de facilitar su integración plena en el mercado laboral. Cada individuo, con sus capacidades singulares, aporta una riqueza invaluable a nuestra comunidad, y nuestro compromiso es asegurar que todos tengan la oportunidad de demostrar su valía y contribuir al crecimiento y la diversidad de nuestro equipo.
 ¡Estamos deseando conocerte!

jobs.title: Software Engineer – AI & Data / Agentic AI
jobs.description:
DESCRIPCIÓN
Desde Alvea Soluciones Tecnológicas nos encontramos en búsqueda de un perfil como tú!
Software Engineer para incorporarse a su área de AI & Data y participar en el desarrollo de sistemas de Agentic AI en producción.
Buscamos un perfil con experiencia en Backend y Cloud, desarrollo de APIs y servicios con FastAPI, integración de LLMs mediante AWS Bedrock y experiencia con frameworks de agentes como LangGraph, LangChain o AWS AgentCore.
REQUISITOS
Grado/Máster en Informática, Matemáticas, Física, Ingeniería o similar.
Experiencia en Backend/Cloud Software Engineering y sistemas en producción.
Python, FastAPI, APIs REST y programación asíncrona.
AWS, EKS/Kubernetes, IAM, networking y observabilidad.
Agentic AI, LangGraph/LangChain/AWS AgentCore y MCP Servers.
Evaluación de agentes: LLM-as-Judge y adversarial evaluation.
Arquitecturas event-driven/streaming.
CI/CD, Docker, Git y Terraform/IaC.
SOLID, Design Patterns y Clean Code.
Conocimientos sobre seguridad, latencia, costes, no determinismo y gestión de fallos en sistemas de IA.
Mentalidad de producto y capacidad para trabajar en entornos dinámicos.
Proyecto estable y de larga duración.
Crecimiento profesional.
jobs.tailored_advice: Para destacar en esta oferta, enfatiza en tu CV proyectos donde hayas llevado modelos de IA a producción, no solo prototipos. Detalla tu experiencia con LangGraph o LangChain mencionando cómo gestionaste el no-determinismo y la latencia. Es crucial que incluyas ejemplos de despliegue en AWS EKS y cómo aplicaste principios de observabilidad para monitorear agentes. Si tienes experiencia con 'LLM-as-Judge' o evaluación adversarial, resáltalo en una sección de 'AI Engineering' para diferenciarte de perfiles backend tradicionales.
jobs.cover_letter: El desarrollo de sistemas de Agentic AI en producción es el área donde quiero enfocar mi carrera, y el stack tecnológico de Alvea Soluciones Tecnológicas encaja perfectamente con mi perfil técnico y mi capacidad de aprendizaje autónomo. He seguido de cerca la evolución de frameworks como LangChain y LangGraph, integrándolos en proyectos personales para crear asistentes inteligentes que van más allá de simples respuestas, buscando siempre una arquitectura robusta y escalable. Mi experiencia construyendo aplicaciones completas, desde la lógica de backend hasta el despliegue, me ha permitido entender la importancia de la eficiencia y la gestión de datos en tiempo real. -Captar los requisitos del cliente y traducirlos en propuestas de solución técnica y especificaciones de integración.

-Mantener una comunicación escrita e incorporar diariamente herramientas de codificación y gestión del conocimiento asistidas por inteligencia artificial.

-Salario: 45K.

jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description:
The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image.

The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

 

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

 

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

 

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

 

Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project.

 

Qualification path

 

No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

Ubicación: Bilbao

Modalidad: Híbrido
Se busca un/a Software Developer SAP  ISU y CRM para incorporarse al equipo del sector energético, con un enfoque principal en la en el desarrollo y resolución de incidencias relacionadas con los sistemas SAP . La persona seleccionada será responsable de diagnosticar y resolver problemas dentro del sistema, realizando pruebas exhaustivas para garantizar que las soluciones sean correctas y estén listas para su paso a producción.
Responsabilidades principales:
Diagnóstico y resolución de incidencias en sistemas SAP ISU y CRM.
Realización de pruebas exhaustivas para validar soluciones antes de su implementación en producción.
Mantenimiento de contacto frecuente con clientes, colaborando para encontrar soluciones efectivas que se ajusten a sus necesidades.
Comunicación y coordinación con los diferentes equipos para asegurar el cumplimiento de los requisitos del sector energético y los estándares de SAP ISU y CRM.
Implementación de mejoras y seguimiento de los procesos para garantizar altos niveles de satisfacción del cliente.
Testeo y análisis de incidencias en el sistema SAP.
Apoyo en el desarrollo, preparación y testeo de solicitudes de cambios en el sistema SAP.
Apoyo general para la mejora, innovación y corrección de errores, dedicada a la gestión de deuda y llamadas a clientes.
Ejecución de tareas manuales periódicas u ocasionales para la corrección de datos.
Qualifications
Requisitos imprescindibles:
Licenciatura en Informática, Telecomunicaciones o campo técnico similar de estudio o experiencia práctica equivalente.
Experiencia mínima de 2 años en desarrollo SAP ABAP.
Conocimientos y experiencia en SAP HANA (preferiblemente).
Nivel alto de inglés (deseable C1 o superior), tanto oral como escrito.

Análisis, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones .NET.

Al menos 4 años de experiencia como Programador/a .NET.
Máster o Ingeniería Superior en Informática (imprescindible)
Experiencia en .NET Core y dominio de C#.
Experiencia con Vue.JS para frontend.
Conocimientos avanzados de SQL Server.

Contrato indefinido y jornada completa

jobs.title: Junior Technical Product Engineer – Gaming Hardware/Audio (METADOX)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 
METADOX GmbH is a hardware startup based in Vienna. We develop, produce, and sell soundproof masks for gaming. Our mission is to allow gamers to play any game, any time, without being a nuisance at their homes, thanks to our comfortable and soundproof masks. 
Our goal is to become the go-to global brand for soundproof masks for gaming, extending into other segments like shared offices and AI dictation.
With our latest product, the VEKTA, we are quickly growing worldwide. We're now building a small engineering team in a new office in Sant Cugat del Vallès, Barcelona. 

THE ROLE
We're looking for a Junior Technical Product Engineer to join us on a full-time basis. You'll be part of the development team and be the bridge between customers, support, and development. Handling real technical issues and turning what you learn into product improvements. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO
Technical support: 
Analyze support tickets, identify technical issues, and propose solutions
Communicate directly with customers to clarify issues and follow up on resolutions
Escalate hardware and firmware issues to the development team and track them to closure
 Product quality analysis:
Investigate current VEKTA product issues through support tickets, customer surveys, reviews, customer interviews, feedback: fit, comfort, microphone, compatibility, etc.
Keep track in a structured and categorized log to evaluate and find patterns of the issues and solutions.
Coordinate with the development team to escalate, propose solutions, and resolve issues.
Documentation:
Create guides for customers, gather specs, improve materials in support portal.
Check and rewrite the support documentation to match the products in detail.
Maintain and update product documentation, specs, and development logs.
Development of new products: 
Test prototypes, propose improvements, and develop new concepts.
Coordinate product development with freelancers, the factory, and external partners.
Potential direct work in CAD, electronics, software, etc.
 
YOUR PROFILE
You’ll need:
Degree in engineering (electronics, mechanical, computer science, or similar).
Strong written English. You'll write to customers and produce documentation daily.
Attention to detail. You record findings accurately, verify assumptions, and dig into issues analytically.
Ability to work independently. We're a small team, you set your own priorities.
Nice to have:
Maker mindset. You build things and enjoy figuring out how they work. 
Familiarity with USB audio, consumer electronics, or wearable hardware.
Gamer. You'll understand our customers instantly.
 
ALIGNMENT WITH OUR VALUES
Superior Quality: We are detail-oriented and committed to excellence.
Gamer-Centric: We have affinity for gaming and are committed to supporting gamers’ needs.
Collaborative & Considerate: We are humble and take the needs of the customers seriously. 
Honest & Direct: We keep it real. We say what we mean, skip the marketing fluff, and never overpromise, to our customers or to each other. 
 
WHAT WE OFFER
A small dynamic team in a growing startup where your contributions will directly impact the company’s success.
Flexible working hours and hybrid (office + remote).
Hands-on work in product development for unique and innovative hardware products.
Direct access to decision-making, product development, and users. As we grow, your responsibilities grow with us.
Permanent contract with a 6-month probation period.
Entry level salary with flexibility depending on your qualifications and experience, reviewed after 12 months.
 
APPLICATION
We look forward to your application! Please send a brief cover letter with your CV.
Please avoid writing the cover letter with AI. Although we use AI all the time, we are true to our values when we communicate. We want to know you, what motivates you, why you want to work in METADOX. 
Don’t hesitate to ask if you have any questions.
 
*************************; +34 *********

jobs.description:
Company Description
Devoteam is a leading European consultancy specialising in digital strategy, technology platforms, cybersecurity and business transformation through technology.
Technology is in our DNA, and we believe it acts as a catalyst for positive change, whilst maintaining a balance that enables us to offer our client base world-class technological tools, but always with the personal touch and professionalism of a team that guides them every step of the way.

Job Description
From Devoteam G Cloud we are looking for Cloud Engineer with experience in Google Cloud Platform cloud to join our team of Cloud experts. As a key member of our organization, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Architect, deploy, and manage scalable and secure GCP infrastructure
Implement and optimize DevOps practices to streamline development and operations processes
Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for efficient software delivery
Collaborate with development teams to improve application performance and reliability
Analyze and troubleshoot complex issues in GCP environments
Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) solutions for automated provisioning and management
Develop and maintain documentation for cloud infrastructure and processes
Continuously evaluate and implement new technologies to enhance our cloud capabilities
Ensure compliance with security best practices and industry standards
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
Minimum of 3 years of experience in GCP infrastructure analysis and management
Proven experience with cloud migrations, particularly to GCP
Strong knowledge of Google Cloud Platform services and best practices
Proficiency in DevOps practices and tools
Excellent scripting skills in languages such as Python and Bash
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI)
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
Solid understanding of infrastructure as code (IaC) principles and tools (e.g., Terraform)
Experience with monitoring and logging solutions in cloud environments
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
Fluency in English (B2/C1 level)
Google Cloud certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer) are a plus
jobs.tailored_advice: Dado que la oferta es para un rol Senior en Devoteam, destaca en tu CV proyectos específicos donde hayas migrado cargas de trabajo a GCP. Es fundamental que menciones tu experiencia con Terraform (IaC) y Kubernetes, ya que son requisitos clave. Si tienes certificaciones oficiales de Google Cloud, colócalas en un lugar destacado. Asegúrate de detallar cómo has optimizado pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins o GitLab CI, cuantificando los resultados (ej. reducción de tiempos de despliegue). Finalmente, enfatiza tu capacidad de mentoría, ya que la oferta menciona explícitamente el apoyo a miembros junior.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Junior to Senior Level
jobs.description:
Software Engineer – Junior to Senior Level (all genders) – Valencia (Hybrid)
 
We develop maritime sensor-, navigation-, and automation-systems. We are looking for software engineers at different experience levels — from early-career engineers with strong potential to experienced engineers who can take broader technical responsibility. Join our cross-functional team and enjoy a modern toolchain, close connections to our other locations, and plenty of room to grow and shape the build-up of the site!
 
Key Conditions
Working languages: English (international), Spanish (local team)
Attractive compensation package, aligned with your experience and level, which we will discuss transparently during the process
During the selection process, we will jointly determine the level and scope that best match your experience, strengths, and development path.
 
Your Responsibilities
·Develop and enhance maritime sensor-, navigation-, and automation-systems in close collaboration with your team and stakeholders
·Plan and implement software tasks, including effort estimates, technical implementation, integration, testing, and documentation
·Continuously improve our delivery efficiency and quality, including domain understanding, automation, and AI-assisted development
·Contribute ideas on how we can improve our engineering culture, methods, processes, and collaboration
·Depending on your experience level, take broader ownership for technical concepts, architecture, coordination, mentoring, or cross-team alignment
 
Your Profile
·Degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, or a comparable qualification
·Relevant experience in software development — from first practical experience to several years of professional experience
·Strong analytical thinking, willingness to learn, quality awareness, and interest in high-end solutions for the global maritime market
·An affinity for AI-assisted development and motivation to expand the use of AI pragmatically and responsibly, both in engineering and in our products
·Very good written and spoken English; Spanish is helpful for local collaboration
·Nice to have: experience with complex software systems as well as C++, Python, Qt/QML or ROS2
 
For More Experienced Candidates
·Ability to take technical ownership for larger work packages or software systems
·Confidence in applying modern software engineering practices and making pragmatic technical decisions
·Experience coordinating with stakeholders, supporting planning and risk management, or guiding other engineers
·Motivation to actively help shape the build-up of the Valencia site, including engineering culture, processes, efficiency, and innovation
 
Our Offer
·An innovative working environment in Valencia with a maritime focus and international collaboration
·A local start-up mindset combined with the stability and expertise of an established corporate group
·Flexible working arrangements (hybrid) and a good work-life balance
·Onboarding, mentoring, and development opportunities tailored to your current level and next development steps
·Attractive compensation, e.g. 25 working days of vacation plus public holidays
 
Collective Agreement Framework
The employment relationship is governed by the collective agreement “Convenio colectivo estatal de la industria, las nuevas tecnologías y los servicios del sector del metal”.
Of course, we offer compensation and working conditions that are aligned with the market, your qualifications, and the level agreed during the selection process and may significantly exceed the minimum standards set by the collective agreement.
 
Application Process
Please send us your CV. Optionally, you may include a portfolio or work samples, e.g., GitHub/LinkedIn, or references. The language of this process is English. You do not need to decide in advance whether you are applying for a junior, intermediate, or senior level — we will assess the best fit together during the process.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Finance & Compliance
jobs.description:
Hey there!
  

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.



Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  

  

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.



Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award\-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?



To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar\-raisers with a hands\-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  

  

Ready to be part of the experience?



Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.


Behind the user\-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.


**About the role**
------------------


**Location:** Spain (remote or hybrid)


**What are we looking for:**


**The Finance \& Compliance Team**



Joining this team means having a direct impact on one of the most critical areas of Fever's business: ensuring that every cent of value we generate —across multiple currencies and countries— is calculated, invoiced, and reported with the highest precision, while scaling across millions of transactions.


**What we do:**


* Calculate the company's revenue by applying technology to a complex system of commercial conditions.
* Invoice and settle with our partners in more than 50 countries (and growing every day).
* Invoice our customers, both end\-users and businesses.
* Automate tax reporting and compliance with relevant authorities.
* Build processes for product categorization to ensure correct tax application for each type of product.


**Why this team is special**



Engineers here don't just write code—they shape the product. Together with the Product Manager, you help define and prioritize what to build, directly influencing both the roadmap and the business impact.


**Our mission**



Provide the most accurate and transparent revenue data to our investors and partners, with full traceability showing exactly which taxes are collected, paid, and what revenue and profit we generate per order line.


**Beyond internal operations**



Finance \& Compliance acts like a SaaS partner within the Fever ecosystem, delivering financial, tax, and compliance services to internal teams, partners, and clients. By automating processes end\-to\-end, we enable efficiency, trust, and seamless collaboration at a global scale.


**The challenge**



This is a problem of scale. We process massive volumes of sales per second, with multiple purchase and revenue flows that require high\-quality engineering solutions. If you enjoy Domain\-Driven Design (DDD), event\-driven architectures, and leveraging asyncio for concurrency, this is the perfect playground.


**Why join us**



By joining Finance \& Compliance, you'll help build the financial backbone of a global marketplace for live entertainment—technology that ensures our growth is sustainable, scalable, and trusted by users, partners, and regulators worldwide.


**What would you do at Fever?**


**During your first month at Fever (Onboarding period):**



You'll join a structured onboarding program designed to help you ramp up smoothly. During this period, you will:


* Meet your buddy and team, and get to know Fever's culture and ways of working.
* Set up your local environment and become familiar with our Python\-based stack, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
* Learn about our architecture and observability tools while contributing small improvements and fixes.
* Have your first code running in production and a clear understanding of our delivery flow and processes.
* By the end of the onboarding, you'll be ready to join your long\-term squad and start contributing to larger initiatives.


**After 3 months at Fever:**



You'll be confidently collaborating and delivering at full speed. You will:


* Design and implement end\-to\-end features within your squad.
* Participate in architectural discussions and propose improvements across our services and APIs.
* Work with event\-driven systems and focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Data, and other Engineering teams to enhance our platform and developer experience.


**On your 6th month in Fever:**



You'll be fully established as a key contributor in your team. You will:


* Take ownership of core components and help evolve their architecture.
* Lead by example through code reviews, design sessions, and mentoring.
* Contribute to best practices in areas like scalability, observability, and system design.
* Drive continuous improvement and have a visible impact on how we build high\-performing services at scale.
* Become an expert of your domain, using business context and technical excellence to drive strategic initiatives forward

**About you**
-------------


**Must have skills:**


* Strong knowledge on good practices, testing and design patterns
* You are proficient in business English
* You know how to deliver code from development to production
* Experience with RESTful APIs (implementation and consumption)
* Knowledge of relational databases and SQL


We use these technologies, so it would be a plus if you have experience in:


* Django/Flask \& FastAPI
* PostgreSQL
* Redis
* Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Experience working on agile methodology
* Event communication between services
* Handling services with more than 1000 request/second.
* AWS, Docker and Kubernetes

**Benefits \& Perks**
---------------------


* + **Home office friendly anywhere in Spain** (no office required)
	+ Flexible schedule
	+ Opportunity to have a real impact in a high\-growth global category leader
	+ 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
	+ Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
	+ Great work environment, international team of talented people to work with!
	+ Health insurance from Day 1\.
	+ Learning Budget
	+ English or Spanish Lessons
	+ Gympass Membership
	+ Cobee (tax free allowance on restaurants and transport).
	+ Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow.
	+ Team buildings
	+ Possibility of additional 56 days of parental leave (unpaid)
	+ Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
		- Base Salary: 50\.000 \- 75\.000EUR
		- Total Compensation: 67\.500 \- 100\.000EUR (Including Base, Variable, and Stock Options)
	+ Mac or Dell laptop, up to you!

**About the process**
---------------------



Fever aims to provide the best\-fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like:


* Talent Interview \- 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture and a conversation about your background and experience.
* Engineering Manager Interview \- 1h: A deep dive into your technical expertise and your opportunity to ask anything you need to know about your day to day at Fever.
* Technical Assignment: Your opportunity to demonstrate all you know! We would like to receive it back within 3 days.
* Team Interview \- 2h: A discussion about your proposed solution to the technical challenge and your chance to make sure you know everything you need about Fever.


Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!



If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog \| Tech.Eu \|TechCrunch



Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!



If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.



If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever \- Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Test Enablers)
jobs.description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.


We are looking for a highly motivated **Senior Software Engineer** to join our **Test Enablers** team within Test Platform Engineering (Developer Productivity).



The Test Enablers team builds and operates the platforms that allow Affirm engineering teams to test with confidence. Our systems provide synthetic identities, test data seeding, mocking, deterministic testing workflows and load testing.



Developer Productivity's mission is to dramatically accelerate software development at Affirm while keeping our systems reliable for customers. Our long\-term north star is to scale to 1,000 PRs per day by December 2027\. To reach that goal, Affirm needs validation systems that are fast, trustworthy, automated, and scalable.



This role is central to that effort.



You will design and build platform capabilities that help engineers validate product changes earlier, run safer load tests, reduce reliance on expensive E2E\-only validation, and improve the reliability of CI signals. You will also help prepare Affirm's testing infrastructure for AI\-assisted development workflows, where agents and humans need deterministic, observable, and actionable validation feedback.



Affirm is growing fast, and we want you to help us scale our products and engineering systems 10x and beyond through world\-class developer productivity infrastructure.

 **What You'll Do**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable systems for synthetic identities, test data seeding, mocking, load testing, and deterministic validation workflows.
* Help evolve Affirm's testing strategy from broad E2E\-heavy validation toward a more scalable model with stronger component, integration, contract, performance, and targeted E2E testing.
* Build platform capabilities that make production\-like load testing safer, more repeatable, and easier to operate.
* Improve our test platform so it is reliable, observable, and easier for other teams to adopt.
* Partner with product engineering and infrastructure teams to improve test signal quality, reduce false failures, and support faster validation loops.
* Lead medium\-to\-large technical projects from ambiguous problem definition through design, implementation, rollout, and operational ownership.
* Improve reliability and operational maturity through dashboards, SLOs, alerts, runbooks, and clear ownership models.
* Reduce manual operational load for load testing, including test data creation, environment setup, reporting, and failure diagnosis.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code that can be easily understood and extended by others.
* Contribute to technical specs, RFCs, ADRs, project plans, and other async artifacts that align teams around technical decisions.
* Review code and technical designs, provide constructive feedback, and help raise engineering standards.
* Mentor engineers and help build a culture of practical testing excellence.

  


**What We Look For**


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience.
* Strong backend engineering experience with **Python, Kotlin, Java**, **or similar languages.**
* Experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems, platform infrastructure, internal developer tools, or testing infrastructure.
* Strong ownership and ability to independently drive ambiguous technical work to completion.
* Experience improving system reliability, observability, operational maturity, and maintainability.
* Ability to collaborate across engineering teams and influence technical direction through clear communication.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including async artifacts such as technical specs, RFCs, ADRs, and project plans.
* Strong engineering fundamentals across system design, testing, debugging, reliability, and production operations.
* Operational ownership of critical internal testing platforms, including reliability, observability, alerting, runbooks, and incident readiness.
* Experience with test automation frameworks, test data systems, mocks, contract testing, integration testing, load testing and CI/CD platforms.
* Ability to balance pragmatic delivery with long\-term technical quality.
* Passion for improving developer productivity and product quality through scalable, automated, reliable systems.

  


### **Compensation \& Benefits**


**Base Pay Grade** **\- N**


**Equity Grade** **\- 4**



Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job\-related skills.



Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).



ESP base pay range per year: **€86,000 \- €122,000**

Additional benefits include:


* Flexible Spending Wallets for tech, food and lifestyle
* Away Days \- wellness days to take off work and recharge
* Learning \& Development programs
* Parental benefits
* Employee Resource \& Community Groups


We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this role, but do require that someone is based in Spain for the role.



**Location \- Remote Spain**



**\#LI\-Remote**

Affirm is proud to be a remote\-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office\-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.



We're extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:


* Health care coverage \- Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
* Flexible Spending Wallets \- generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
* Time off \- competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
* ESPP \- An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount


We believe It's On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.



\[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.



By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.

jobs.title: QA / Test Engineer
jobs.description:
**Role description**  

We are looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our team!



More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer and Great Place to Work company with over 35\.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 35 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large\-scale technologic solutions to big companies.


**What we look for?**  

We are looking for a QA / Test Engineer with solid experience in enterprise software quality assurance, preferably within utility, billing, financial, CRM, ERP, or other high\-volume customer platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong functional testing expertise with API, integration, data validation, automation, and regression testing skills.  

You should have a risk\-based testing mindset, strong analytical capabilities, and a focus on ensuring billing accuracy, financial reconciliation, and high\-quality releases. Experience with test automation, SQL, CI/CD practices, and modern testing frameworks is highly valued.

  

**Main tasks and accountabilities will be:**  

Define and execute test strategies, plans, estimates, coverage models, and quality gates aligned with project risks and delivery milestones.  

Design and execute functional, integration, end\-to\-end, API, regression, exploratory, and data validation test scenarios.  

Validate customer, contract, tariff, billing, invoicing, payments, refunds, collections, and financial processes across the platform.  

Perform complex billing verification, including proration, effective dating, taxes, discounts, adjustments, reversals, rebilling, and exception handling.  

Test APIs and event\-driven integrations, ensuring reliability, sequencing, idempotency, error handling, and operational visibility.  

Develop and maintain automated tests and regression suites for APIs, services, and critical business journeys.  

Use SQL for data setup, validation, comparison, migration verification, and reconciliation activities.  

Prepare and manage test environments, test data, customer accounts, meters, tariffs, and usage scenarios.  

Log, track, analyze, and retest defects while collaborating with developers, analysts, and business stakeholders.  

Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) through scenario preparation, execution monitoring, evidence collection, and defect management.  

Contribute to performance, resilience, security, and operational readiness testing activities.  

Support cutover rehearsals, production validation, smoke testing, reconciliation controls, and hypercare activities.

  

**What do we expect from you?**  

4\+ years of experience in software testing and quality assurance within enterprise environments.  

Strong knowledge of:  

Functional Testing  

End\-to\-End Testing  

Integration Testing  

Regression Testing  

Risk\-Based Testing  

Defect Management  

Hands\-on experience with API testing tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or similar.  

Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and migration testing.  

Experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks and automated regression suites.  

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control systems, and automated test execution.  

Ability to analyze complex business rules, pricing structures, effective\-dated logic, financial calculations, and exception flows.  

Experience with automation technologies such as:  

Cucumber  

JUnit  

REST Assured  

Selenium  

Strong communication skills and the ability to produce clear test evidence and defect documentation.  

Good spoken and written English.

  

**Nice to have**  

Utility industry experience, especially customer information and billing platforms.  

Knowledge of platforms such as SAP Utilities, Oracle Utilities, Kraken Technologies, or Hansen.  

Experience with meter\-to\-cash, customer\-to\-cash, market operations, and debt management processes.  

Performance and resilience testing using JMeter, k6, or Gatling.  

Experience with AWS integrations, event\-driven architectures, and cloud observability.  

ISTQB or equivalent testing certification.

  

**Key skills**  

End\-to\-End Testing  

Functional Testing  

Integration Testing  

CI/CD  

Cucumber  

API Testing  

SQL  

Test Automation  

Regression Testing  

Defect Management  

Risk\-Based Testing  

Financial \& Billing Validation  

Agile Delivery Practices


**Work Location**  

100%remote


**Work Schedule**



Business hours.


**What can we offer?**



23 days of Annual Leave plus the 24th and 31st of December as discretionary days!



Numerous benefits (Health Care Plan, teleworking compensation, Life and Accident Insurances).



\`Retribución Flexible´ Program: (Meals, Kinder Garden, Transport, online English lessons, Health Care Plan…)



Free access to several training platforms



Professional stability and career plans



UST also, compensates referrals from which you could benefit when you refer professionals.



The option to pick between 12 or 14 payments along the year.



Real Work Life Balance measures (flexibility, WFH or remote work policy, compacted hours during summertime…)



UST Club Platform discounts and gym Access discounts



If you would like to know more, don’t hesitate to apply and we’ll get in touch to fill you in detail. We are waiting for you!



In UST we are committed to equal opportunities in our selection processes and do not discriminate based on race, gender, disability, age, religion, sexual orientation or nationality. We have a special commitment to Disability \& Inclusion, so we are interested in hiring people with disability certificate.

 **Skills**  

End\-to\-End Testing, Functional Testing, Integration Testing, CI/CD, Cucumber

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

¡Sigue leyendo!

Python 3 avanzado.
Conocimientos medios de C/C++.
Experiencia con Linux, Docker, Terraform, UnitTest, Kubernetes.

Conocimientos en Cloud (AWS).
Bases de datos: Redis, ElasticSearch.
Valorable:
Experiencia con plataformas de monitorización como Grafana.
Conocimiento en plataformas de planificación y automatización de procesos.
Interés por aprender nuevas tecnologías.
Inglés nivel B2.

Incorporación a una empresa multinacional competitiva en continuo crecimiento.
Integración en un equipo de profesionales altamente cualificado, con un buen clima laboral, innovador y dinámico.
Formación especializada y desarrollo profesional continuo.

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

The digital society wouldn’t be possible without us. Our employees provide our customers with the best network, with a reliable and secure infrastructure. The basis for tomorrow's innovations. We have the best prospects for the digital future. For you right from the start.
