jobs.description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**
------------------


ElevenLabs spends meaningfully on paid acquisition, and that spend is only as good as the data behind it. We are looking for an engineer to own our measurement layer end to end: the tag manager setup, the tracking and attribution scripts on our sites, and the server\-to\-server conversion tracking that feeds our ad platforms.


Day to day you will work closely with the paid marketing team: fixing tracking bugs as they come in, setting up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debugging discrepancies between platform\-reported conversions and our internal data. Longer term, you will define how tracking should properly work here and build the monitoring so we catch breakage in hours, not weeks.


This role sits between frontend engineering, data engineering, and marketing. You will add and improve tracking scripts without hurting pagespeed, keep our server\-side GTM container healthy, make sure consent and regional restrictions are correctly enforced, and ensure the right channels get credit for the right conversions. Your work directly decides how a large paid budget gets allocated.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own our tag manager setup end to end, including the server\-side GTM container, and review any changes other teams want to make
* Work with the paid marketing team daily: fix tracking bugs, set up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debug discrepancies between platform\-reported conversions and our internal data
* Build and maintain server\-to\-server conversion tracking (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, and similar) and validate pixel vs server deduplication
* Improve tracking script performance and correctness, keeping script impact on pagespeed and Core Web Vitals within budget
* Make sure consent handling and regional restrictions are correctly enforced across markets
* Define event schema and UTM conventions, and document them so tracking for new campaigns is correct by default
* Build monitoring and alerting for the measurement stack so we catch broken tracking within hours, not weeks
* Review PRs that add conversion events to the main app, and work with product engineering on tracking integrations

**Requirements**
----------------

* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, comfortable working in both frontend code and a production application codebase
* Hands\-on experience with Google Tag Manager, including server\-side GTM, and at least one conversion API (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or similar) implemented server\-to\-server
* Experience debugging attribution discrepancies end to end: pixel vs server deduplication, UTM conventions, event schema design
* Solid understanding of web performance and how to add tracking without degrading Core Web Vitals
* Working knowledge of consent and privacy requirements (Consent Mode v2, regional restrictions) and SQL for validating tracking data in the warehouse

**Bonus**
---------

* CDP experience (Segment, RudderStack, Snowplow)
* Product analytics tools (GA4, Amplitude, PostHog) and dbt
* Next.js experience
* Exposure to incrementality testing or media mix modelling

**Growth potential**
--------------------


We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

* Own the whole martech and measurement area as it grows, potentially leading a small marketing engineering team
* Grow toward senior/staff IC on the engineering track
* Broaden into data engineering and attribution modelling, or into growth engineering more widely (experimentation, landing page infrastructure)

**Location**
------------


This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

  

\#LI\-Remote


We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Staff Core Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.**


n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no\-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500\+ builder\-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.


Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 \- working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K\+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment \- bringing us to a $5\.2bn valuation

  

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out \- whether you’re technical or not \- and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.


We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


Your main goal will be to shape and evolve the core platform architecture that powers n8n — creating scalable, configurable foundations across execution, infrastructure, and frontend platform so 80\+ product engineers and our open\-source community can build confidently across cloud and self\-hosted deployments.


Working across our platform teams, you’ll bring architectural coherence to the systems they jointly own and help us make the right long\-term technical decisions as n8n scales:

### **Architectural direction across Core Platform**

* Drive architecture across the two Core Platform teams, ensuring execution, infrastructure, data, and frontend platform systems evolve as a coherent whole rather than independent components.
* Design highly adaptable backend foundations that support different workloads, deployment models, shared product team needs, and future scale without creating unnecessary complexity.
* Partner with the FE platform workstream on core canvas architecture, real\-time communication, performance, plugin contracts, and other platform primitives used by product teams.

### **Execution, distributed systems \& data foundations**

* Evolve core subsystems including durable workflow execution and state, orchestration, queue and task distribution, worker management, scheduling, and horizontal scaling.
* Design for correctness and resilience across distributed environments, including failure modes, idempotency, state transitions, tenant isolation, and reliability guarantees.
* Shape our data and persistence architecture, including database scaling, sharding, migration strategies, deployment abstractions, and long\-term operational maintainability.

### **Platform architecture \& engineering enablement**

* Lead consequential technical decisions through clear proposals and RFCs, making trade\-offs explicit and aligning engineers and stakeholders around durable solutions.
* Define stable platform interfaces and abstractions that reduce coupling, support safe migrations, and make the platform easier for feature teams to build on.
* Mentor engineers across all engineering teams through design reviews, pairing, and technical guidance, raising the bar for architecture, system design, and maintainability.

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

### **Must\-haves**

* **Staff\-level architectural ownership:** You have a track record of leading architecture across multiple systems or teams, including migrations, re\-architectures, or foundational platform initiatives with long\-term organizational impact.
* **Systems thinking:** You reason deeply about invariants, correctness, failure modes, boundaries, and trade\-offs, and you’re comfortable making decisions where there is no obviously perfect solution.
* **Configurable systems at scale:** You’ve designed highly configurable, adaptable systems that serve multiple use cases or operating modes without becoming brittle or excessively complex.
* **Distributed systems depth:** You’ve designed and operated distributed systems involving concepts such as asynchronous processing, idempotency, state machines, queues, consistency, and resilience.
* **Data architecture at scale:** You’ve worked on data\-intensive systems where persistence, performance, isolation, migrations, and operational reliability were meaningful architectural concerns.
* **TypeScript \& Node.js depth:** You have strong TypeScript experience and have built substantial backend systems with Node.js beyond conventional CRUD applications.
* **Cross\-team technical leadership:** You influence through technical judgment, clear communication, RFCs, design reviews, and mentorship, helping multiple teams converge on better solutions without relying on formal authority.
* **Platform enablement mindset:** You care about creating clear contracts, abstractions, and developer experiences that allow other engineers to move faster and more safely.
* **Long\-horizon engineering:** You’re energized by modularization, migrations, refactoring, and evolving existing systems while keeping the product and engineering organization moving.

### **Nice\-to\-haves**

* **Workflow, orchestration or devtools experience:** You’ve worked on workflow engines, orchestration platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure\-heavy SaaS products.
* **Frontend platform architecture:** You’ve worked with architecture\-heavy frontend systems such as canvas applications, plugin systems, real\-time applications, web workers, or complex rendering environments.
* **Durable execution patterns:** You’ve designed or operated systems using event sourcing, sagas, durable execution, or related state\-management patterns.
* **Multi\-tenant architecture:** You’ve designed systems where tenant isolation, resource management, data boundaries, or noisy\-neighbour concerns were important.
* **Open\-source experience:** You’ve contributed to or maintained open\-source software and understand the additional pressure around public contracts and backward compatibility.
* **Large\-scale SaaS exposure:** You’ve operated systems at meaningful scale or worked in environments where reliability and architectural decisions had broad customer impact.
* **Monolith modular migrations:** You’ve decomposed monolithic systems or led incremental architectural migrations without preventing product teams from continuing to ship.
* **Multi\-deployment awareness:** You’ve designed products that need to work consistently across both managed cloud and self\-hosted environments.
* **Observability mindset:** You think about instrumentation, debugging, incident response, rollout safety, and operability as part of system design rather than an afterthought.
* **Strong CS grounding:** You bring deep knowledge of distributed systems concepts, consistency models, consensus, formal methods, or similarly rigorous approaches to system correctness.

**Why join us?**


At n8n, you’ll work on the foundations that almost every product experience depends on. You’ll have influence across two Core Platform teams, helping shape how our execution engine, infrastructure, data architecture, and frontend platform evolve together as both our product and engineering organization scale.


This is a Staff role with real architectural leverage: you’ll tackle problems that span team boundaries, evolve systems that already operate at meaningful scale, and create platform capabilities that make 80\+ engineers more effective. You’ll do that in a remote\-first environment that values autonomy, thoughtful experimentation, and engineers who influence through strong technical judgment rather than hierarchy.


Sound like the kind of platform challenge you want to own?


Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

*n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

*We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.*

***Our company language is English.***

*You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our* *Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n* *(**https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity\-inclusion\-and\-belonging\-n8n\-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35**).*

***Location disclaimer:*** *If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.*

**Benefits**
------------

* **Competitive compensation** – We offer fair and attractive pay.
* **Ownership** – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.
* **Work/life balance** – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:


	+ **Europe:** 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.
	+ **US:** 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.
* **Health \& wellness** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US**: Multiple low\-premium, low\-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no\-cost premium HDHP option with a pre\-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.
* **Future planning** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US:** 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.
* **Financial security** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US:** Company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.
* **Career growth** – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.
* **A passionate team** – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!
* **Remote\-first** – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off\-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.
* **Giving back** – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.
* **Transparency** – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.
* *Country\-specific details are provided in your contract.*


Compensation Range: €127\.5K \- €175\.3K

Highlight specific instances where you led cross-team initiatives, managed complex migrations, or defined technical standards that improved developer velocity. Emphasize your experience with distributed systems (idempotency, state machines, queue management) and provide concrete examples of how you handled trade-offs in high-scale environments. Since n8n values open-source contributions, explicitly list any public projects or maintainer roles. Finally, follow their instruction: build a workflow in n8n and include a link or screenshot in your application to demonstrate immediate engagement with their product.

jobs.title: Customer Retention Manager
jobs.description:
**About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)**
======================================



Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today's hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:


* Predictable performance, even at scale
* Secure, compliant environments by default
* Real\-time observability and profiling built in
* Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
* AI\-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow\-the\-sun\-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.


Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.


What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.


Our values:



 We make a positive impact.



✨ We aim for the stars.



 We care for each other.


**Impact of a Customer Retention Manager**
==========================================



As our Customer Retention Manager, you play a key role in protecting and growing revenue across a high\-volume portfolio of customer accounts. Your day\-to\-day is proactive, human outreach and health monitoring — building real relationships at scale, bringing a human touch to segments that are often managed purely through automation, and catching risk early. When you manage that well, renewal conversations become a natural next step rather than the main event. You'll also work within the workflows, health scoring, automation, and segmentation that let retention scale without creating internal chaos, all while keeping the renewal experience smart, timely, and low\-friction.



Reporting to our VP, Customer Success, this role is ideal for someone who loves building, improving processes, testing ideas, and seeing direct impact on both customer outcomes and business performance. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Data, and GTM teams to inform retention strategy and engagement models across the business.


**What to expect**
==================

  

* **Renewal Ownership \& Pipeline Management:** Manage a rolling pipeline of customer renewals across a high\-volume portfolio, initiating conversations ahead of contract expiration and driving each account through to close.
* **Retention Workflow Support:** Help build and improve scalable retention and renewal workflows using Salesforce and integrated tooling, contributing to repeatable processes that hold up as portfolio volume grows.
* **Proactive Relationship Building:** Own direct, human outreach to smaller and long\-tail accounts by proactively building relationships with them.
* **Lifecycle \& Tech\-Touch Design:** Contribute to the design of customer lifecycle journeys, engagement triggers, and tech\-touch motions
* **Health Scoring \& Risk Identification:** Use customer health scoring frameworks\- built on usage, engagement, and lifecycle signals\- to identify at\-risk accounts early, partnering with internal stakeholders to develop and execute save strategies.
* **Automation \& AI Enablement:** Support the implementation of automated outreach, lifecycle campaigns, and renewal risk workflows, and flag opportunities to leverage AI and automation.
* **Commercial Negotiation:** Negotiate pricing, contract terms, and multi\-year agreements within established company guidelines.
* **Expansion Identification:** Partner with Customer Success Managers and Account Executives to identify and close upsell and cross\-sell opportunities during the renewal cycle.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Data, and GTM teams to support and inform retention strategy and customer engagement models.

**What you bring**
==================

  

* **Renewal Lifecycle Experience:** Experience managing a rolling renewal pipeline, engaging customers well in advance of contract expiration.
* **Commercial Negotiation Skills:** Experience negotiating pricing, contract terms, and multi\-year agreements within established guidelines.
* **Risk Identification \& Save Strategy:** Ability to identify at\-risk accounts early and collaborate cross\-functionally on save strategies.
* **CRM \& Systems Experience:** Hands\-on experience working within Salesforce or a similar CRM, including contributing to operational workflows or lifecycle processes.
* **Retention \& Lifecycle Knowledge:** Solid understanding of customer health scoring, lifecycle automation, and retention strategy.
* **Expansion Mindset:** Proven ability to identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities in partnership with CSMs and Account Executives.
* **Versatility:** Comfort operating across both customer\-facing engagement conversations and systems/process design conversations.
* **Growth Mindset:** Demonstrates a sustained commitment to continuous improvement, actively seeking out better ways to engage customers and support scalable operations.

**Where we hire**
=================



At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend \- it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in **the UK,** **France, Spain, Germany or Canada**. Although we're unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.


**How we hire**
===============



We know that a great hire won't meet every requirement that we've outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.


You can expect **4 video interviews** on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you're looking for in your future working environment.



* 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition


* 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (VP, Customer Success)


* 60 Minutes with Team (IC's)


* 45 Minutes with Executive (COO)



*All roles require background checks.*


**What we offer**
=================



**A product you can believe in** \- Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud **B Corp**.


**An Award\-Winning Workplace** \- We've been recognized by Forbes' Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France's Best Workplaces for Women.



️ **A culture that values your voice** \- Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.



**A global team** \- Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives


**Benefits and perks** \- Make the most of what matters to you



 Flexible PTO



 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)



 Company stock options



 Professional development budget



 Office equipment budget



‍️ Wellness budget



 Annual team gatherings



 Internet reimbursement



 Inclusive parental leave



✈️ Remote work travel program



**You belong here**
===================



At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.
jobs.tailored_advice: Since this role focuses on high-volume renewals and tech-touch design, highlight your experience with Salesforce automation and health scoring frameworks in your CV. Finally, showcase your ability to balance 'human touch' relationship building with scalable, automated processes, as this is central to the position.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer – API Testing
jobs.description:
We are a global technology consulting company specializing in IT solutions, cloud\-based platforms, mobile and web applications, and training and support services. With over 14 years of experience and a multicultural team of more than 100 professionals, we deliver projects for highly complex industries such as pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, healthcare, and consumer goods.



At our company, we value international talent, diversity, flexibility, and a collaborative environment that fosters both professional growth and personal well\-being.


### **About the role**



At Nuvolar, we are looking for a **Senior QA Engineer** to join one of our **healthcare projects**, working on digital health solutions that support complex workflows and critical software platforms.



You will become part of a technical team responsible for ensuring the quality of a platform that manages sensitive healthcare information, integrations, and services within a complex digital health ecosystem.This role is a great opportunity for a QA Engineer who enjoys understanding **complex products, defining quality strategies, designing meaningful test scenarios**, and collaborating closely with developers and product teams to deliver reliable software.



As the first QA Engineer joining this product team, you'll have the opportunity to shape how quality is built into the product from the early stages. Rather than joining an established QA function within the team, you'll define testing strategies, introduce best practices, and help embed quality throughout the development lifecycle while working closely with developers and product stakeholders.


### **What You'll Do**


* **Define and execute the QA strategy** for backend services, APIs, integrations, and critical product workflows.
* Understand the product domain and translate business requirements into effective test scenarios.
* **Design, maintain, and execute test plans** covering functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, exploratory testing, and edge cases.
* Perform backend and API testing using tools such as Postman and OpenAPI/Swagger specifications.
* Validate REST APIs, data consistency, error handling, authentication flows, and integration scenarios.
* Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL to validate data integrity and support testing activities.
* Contribute to test automation initiatives by maintaining and improving automated test suites.
* Analyse logs, traces, and system behaviour using monitoring and observability tools.
* Collaborate closely with developers, Product Owners, and technical stakeholders to identify risks early and ensure release readiness.
* **Drive continuous improvement of QA practices** and help establish quality standards within the team.

### **✅** **What We're Looking For**


* Proven experience as a QA Engineer working on **software products, backend services, REST APIs,** or integration\-heavy platforms.
* Strong experience with **API testing** using Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, or similar tools.
* Experience creating, maintaining, or improving automated test suites.
* Solid understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, regression testing, exploratory testing, integration testing, and defect management.
* Experience working with relational databases and SQL to validate data integrity and application behaviour.
* Knowledge of cloud environments, ideally **AWS**, with a practical understanding of services such as DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, and Secrets Manager.
* Experience working with **GitHub and CI/CD workflows**, ideally GitHub Actions.
* AI literacy, including familiarity with **AI\-assisted tools**, AI agents, or the practical use of AI to improve testing, automation, and documentation.
* Ability to understand complex technical environments, identify quality risks, and work collaboratively with developers and product teams.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Professional level of **English,** both written and spoken.

### **Nice to have**


* Experience working in healthcare, digital health, medical software, or other regulated environments.
* Previous experience with patient data, identity management, or clinical workflows.
* Knowledge of Spring Boot, Java, Maven, or Java backend ecosystems.
* Experience with Playwright.
* Experience replacing or modernising existing automation frameworks.
* Experience with contract testing, distributed systems, or end\-to\-end integration testing.
* Experience with Docker and containerised development or testing environments.

### **Why You'll Love Working at Nuvolar**


* **Flexible Work \& Work\-Life Balance:** enjoy options to balance work and personal life, including every other Friday off.
* **Remote Work:** this is a fully remote position, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere in Spain while staying closely connected with your team.
* **Seniority Program:** enjoy additional benefits and privileges as you grow with the company.
* **Social \& Team Budget:** even though we primarily work remotely, we encourage team gatherings and activities, with a dedicated budget.
* **Continuous Learning:** access training, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.
* **Growth Opportunities:** participate in challenging healthcare technology projects, work with modern technologies, shape the QA strategy of a growing product team, and contribute to the evolution of quality engineering practices.

### **The Hiring Process**


**1\. Project \& Role Introduction**  

A first conversation with one of our engineering team members to introduce the project, explain the role in detail, and answer your initial questions about the opportunity.


**2\. Technical Assessment**  

You'll complete a take\-home QA challenge designed to evaluate your technical approach, testing strategy, and problem\-solving skills.


**3\. Technical Interview**  

A discussion with our engineering team to review your assessment, explore your technical experience, and talk through real\-world testing scenarios, technical decisions, and your way of working.


**4\. Cultural Fit Interview**  

A conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to learn more about your background, career goals, and what you're looking for in your next opportunity. It's also a chance for you to ask any remaining questions about Nuvolar, our culture, and the role.


**5\. Client Interview** *(if required)*  

Depending on the project, there may be a final conversation with the client to discuss the role, the team, and how you'll collaborate within the project environment.



In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an "imperfect" CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don't self\-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you'll be asked to complete one or more tests.



 Join a team where trust, growth, and purpose go hand in hand. Apply now and let's build meaningful tech — together, from anywhere.



If you want to be aware of all of our latest updates, follow us via**LinkedIn** **\|** **Instagram** **\|** **Glassdoor** **\|** **Medium**


*Equal Opportunity Statement*  

*Nuvolar Works is an equal\-opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on age, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, family or marital status, disability, national origin, race, ethnicity, religion, or any other protected characteristic. Candidates with disabilities are encouraged to apply, and we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Product Security Engineer

Application Security

* Review application architecture and new product features from a security perspective.

* Perform threat modeling and security design reviews.
* Support internal and external penetration testing activities.

* Build and improve Secure SDLC across engineering teams.
* Integrate security tooling into CI/CD pipelines.
* Improve developer security practices and provide technical guidance.
* Help engineering teams remediate vulnerabilities.


Cloud \& Infrastructure Security

* Improve the security posture of our cloud infrastructure.
* Secure Kubernetes environments, IAM policies, secrets management, and infrastructure components.
* Implement security monitoring and hardening best practices.
* Work closely with Platform and DevOps teams.


Security Automation

* Deploy and maintain SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container scanning, and secret detection.
* Automate security checks and developer workflows.
* Continuously improve security visibility across the engineering organization.

  

**Requirements**  

* 4\+ years of experience in Product Security, Application Security, Software Engineering, or Security Engineering.
* Strong software engineering background.
* Experience securing backend systems, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

jobs.description:
**About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)**
======================================



Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today's hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:


* Predictable performance, even at scale
* Secure, compliant environments by default
* Real\-time observability and profiling built in
* Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
* AI\-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow\-the\-sun\-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.


Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.


What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.


Our values:



 We make a positive impact.



✨ We aim for the stars.



 We care for each other.


**Impact of a Senior Analytics Engineer**
=========================================



As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will join our Data Science and Engineering team at Upsun to help our company make smarter choices. You will do this by helping us better understand our customers and internal operations. You will work with large amounts of platform and business data to create clear insights that improve our product and decisions. In this role, you will use **SQL**, **Python**, **DBT**, **Hex**, **Metabase**, and **GCP** data tools. You will work on important projects like building new data models with Salesforce and financial data, or working with AI tools and cloud cost modeling (FinOps).


**What to expect**


* **Data modeling and architecture:** You will design and build models that turn raw data into useful metrics and data products, using DBT and medallion architecture.
* **Metric design \& ownership:** You will define what success looks like for our products, setting up and tracking key business metrics.
* **Cross\-functional collaboration:** You will work with technical and non\-technical teams to collect requirements, share methods, and teach best practices for using data.
* **Technical leadership:** You will lead data modeling projects, choosing the right tools and planning how to complete the work.
* **Scalable solutions:** You will work efficiently with data of all sizes, including petabyte\-scale datasets, to help everyone make data\-based decisions.
* **Strategic advisory:** You will guide partner teams by creating and explaining analytical metrics, helping them understand how data impacts different parts of the product and business.
* **Operational efficiency:** You will improve our team's processes and code by creating well\-documented solutions that can be used again in the future.
* **Evolving modern stack:** You will use modern tools (GCP BigQuery, AWS S3, Fivetran, Hightouch, and AI tools like Claude Code) and help us improve our data architecture as it grows.
* **Global remote culture:** You will work with a worldwide, remote team that values learning, open source software, and new ideas.

**What you bring**
==================


* **Core skills:** Strong experience with **SQL** and **DBT** in real production settings, along with good habits in **Python**, **Git**, and **CI/CD**.
* **Data architecture:** Solid experience building data models for large datasets (up to petabytes) in cloud platforms like **GCP** or **AWS**.
* **Curiosity and problem solving:** A passion for testing new tools, learning new technologies, and finding simple ways to solve complex problems.
* **Execution \& tradeoffs:** The ability to choose the best solution among different technical options, communicate clearly, and work well asynchronously.
* **Clear communication:** Experience creating solutions and explaining them clearly to different types of audiences.
* **Remote collaboration:** Comfort working in a remote team, managing your time well, and working across multiple teams.

**Bonus**
=========


* Prior experience working with FinOps principles or FOCUS data models.
* Experience or interest in building AI data agents and modern AI\-assisted data workflows.

**Where we hire**
=================



At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend \- it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in **France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom**. Although we're unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.


**How we hire**
===============



We know that a great hire won't meet every requirement that we've outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.


You can expect **4** interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you're looking for in your future working environment.



* 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition


* 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, Data Engineering and Data Science)


* 60 Minutes with Team (ICs)


* 45 Minutes with Executive (CFO)



*All roles require background checks.*


**What we offer**
=================



**A product you can believe in** \- Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud **B Corp**.


**An Award\-Winning Workplace** \- We've been recognized by Forbes' Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France's Best Workplaces for Women.



️ **A culture that values your voice** \- Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.



**A global team** \- Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives


**Benefits and perks** \- Make the most of what matters to you



 Flexible PTO



 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain)



 Company stock options program



 Professional development budget



 Office equipment budget



‍️ Wellness budget



 Annual team gatherings



 Internet reimbursement



 Inclusive parental leave



✈️ Remote work travel program



**You belong here**
===================



At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.
jobs.tailored_advice: Since you have a 35/100 match score, you must bridge the gap by highlighting specific projects where you used DBT for complex data modeling and SQL for large-scale datasets. Since this is a Senior role, emphasize your experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows, as these are explicitly requested. Mention any experience with FinOps or cloud cost optimization, as this is a key project area for the team. Finally, since they value remote collaboration and asynchronous communication, provide concrete examples of how you have led data projects across cross-functional teams in a remote setting.

jobs.title: Network Engineer - Cloud Operations
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  

  

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.


Varian is seeking a Network Engineer position in support of our Managed Services global business. Our goal is to provide good operational practices and support for the operations, maintenance, and refinement of Varian’s public and private Cloud environments and services. Providing support for new and legacy applications and services hosted in the cloud, and continuous improvement of Varian’s Cloud infrastructure. The candidate will support Varian’s cloud operations to enhance, optimize, and maintain computing capabilities across our entire global cloud solution. Including collaboration with Service, Operations, Product Management and Security. The Network Engineer must have expertise with Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) \& Microsoft Azure. Additional responsibilities for delivering support to the infrastructure and deployment of Varian’s applications as a Managed Service, and provide input in developing and maintaining policies, procedures, and standards. The position will receive direction from the Manager of Global Cloud Operations.
Varian is seeking a Cloud Network Implementation Architect with a strong background in Palo Alto Networks to support of our Managed Services global business. You will support Varian’s cloud operations to enhance, optimize, and maintain computing capabilities across our entire global cloud solution. Including collaboration with Service, Operations, Product Management and Security. The Network Engineer must have expertise with Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) \& Microsoft Azure. Additional responsibilities for delivering support to the infrastructure and deployment of Varian’s applications as a Managed Service, and provide input in developing and maintaining policies, procedures, and standards. The position will receive direction from the Manager of Global Cloud Operations. Our goal is to provide good operational practices and support for the operations, maintenance, and refinement of Varian’s public and private Cloud environments and services. Providing support for new and legacy applications and services hosted in the cloud, and continuous improvement of Varian’s Cloud infrastructure.

 **You are responsible for:**

* Providing network operations and support for Varian’s cloud solutions. Private, public and hybrid infrastructure, network and security.
* Assisting with upgrading, installing, and configuring various cloud solutions including monitoring, application access, security, Palo Alto Networks (Highly Recommended), Citrix NetScaler, Citrix ADC
* Assisting with reporting on current infrastructure status, and planning for future usage.
* Configuring and supporting backbone connections over ExpressRoute (Azure), and direct connection and VPN architecture.
* Maintaining allocation of IP CIDR block, perform maintenance involving modification of network, subnets, vlans, routes etc.
* Verifying and action on events aggregated from network monitoring tools and Web Application Firewall using Varian approved tools.
* Troubleshooting and determining root cause of issues.
* Collaborating to quickly resolve any network related outages and resolve customer impacting issues quickly.
* Contributing to the successful execution of projects.
* Creating, updating, and completing documentation.
* Investigate root cause analysis of incidents with follow up reporting and final content generation.
* Collaborating with network engineers on procedures, techniques, tips \& knowledge to improve operations, security and work performed.
* Providing the highest level of customer service.
* Advance understanding of vendor and telco/exchange/service providers support escalation paths and being able to escalate support requests to these vendors in a typically urgent and timely fashion.
* Appling network system updates, patches, configuration changes.
* Planning network layouts and configures systems to user environments.
* Serving as a technical mentor to colleagues as necessary.
* Staying up to date with assigned Learning Management System courses.
* Maintaining a strong knowledge of Varian’s suite of applications.
* Eagerness to provide the highest level of customer service.
* On call support as required.
* Working schedule EMEA business hours.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Degree in computer science, or other engineering or technical discipline is preferred, or equivalent (5\-7 years of additional specific relevant experience may be substituted for education).
* Experience in supporting and managing networks in an enterprise cloud computing environment.


	+ Deep understanding of network protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, ARP,), addressing, NAT and subnetting, CIDR.
	+ Routing and Switching expertise in dynamic routing protocols like OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, and MPLS. Experience with VLANs, STP, and layer 2/3 concepts.
	+ Network Performance Analysis, with the ability to interpret packet captures using tools like Wireshark, tcpdump, iperf, or SolarWinds as examples.
	+ Network Performance Analysis: Ability to interpret packet captures using tools like Wireshark, tcpdump, iperf, or SolarWinds for example.
	+ WAN and VPN knowledge of technologies such as MPLS, SD\-WAN, IPsec, and SSL VPNs. Microsoft ExpressRoute experience preferred.
	+ Skills in hybrid networking setups and cloud\-based solutions. Azure Virtual Network.
	+ Hands\-on experience with Palo Alto Network Firewalls, including hands\-on experience with routers, switches, load balancers, and firewalls (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Citrix NetScaler, etc.).
* Network Security Concepts


	+ Expertise in firewalls, IDS/IPS systems, access control lists (ACLs), and DDoS mitigation.
	+ Authentication and Encryption knowledge of RADIUS, TACACS\+, PKI, and SSL/TLS.
* Hands on experience troubleshooting telecom/peering partner/peering provider networks.
* Understanding of vendor and telco/exchange/service providers support escalation paths and being able to escalate support requests to these vendors in a typically urgent and timely fashion.
* Experience working with business critical, highly available/scalable infrastructure and applications.
* Experience with ticket handling and processing.
* Clear communicator, ability to communicate technical terms to business and customer stakeholders.
* Experience in supporting and managing networks in an enterprise cloud computing environment.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure Networking services and features.
* Hands\-on experience with Palo Alto Networks (required), Cisco and Juniper devices and features
* Experience working with highly business critical, highly available/scalable infrastructure and applications.
* ITIL knowledge and experience with Incident, Problem, Change and other process disciplines.
* Experience creating diagram documentation (Visio/Lucidchart)
* Experience writing technical documentation, especially in relation to Cloud architecture.
* Will be required to write as built, operating procedures and instructions, templates.
* Hands\-on experience with firewalls, managed switches and router configurations

**Mandatory Technical Requirements**

* **Palo Alto Networks (PAN) firewalls**
* **Palo Alto certification \>\>** ***If you do not have the certification, please do not apply as we can only take through candidates who have this certification***
* **Azure Networking**
* **Azure ExpressRoute**
* **Telco / carrier networking experience** (strong plus)
* **Citrix NetScaler**

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision\-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work**: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.


To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.


As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

**Data Privacy**: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.

**Beware of Job Scams:** Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees. These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information. If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.


**To all recruitment agencies**: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

Emphasize your hands-on experience with Azure ExpressRoute and Citrix NetScaler, as these are specific technical requirements. Since this is a Managed Services role, showcase your experience with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change management) and your ability to document complex network architectures using tools like Visio or Lucidchart. Finally, explicitly mention your experience in troubleshooting carrier/telco peering issues, as this is noted as a strong plus.

jobs.title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a **Senior ServiceNow Developer** to join our team in Madrid, Spain in a hybrid working mode. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing and maintaining ServiceNow solutions to enhance efficiency and improve user experience across critical IT processes. You will work on Business Request Catalog, case management and custom components for self\-service portals, leveraging best practices to deliver sustainable, upgrade\-safe solutions.


This is a hands\-on development role with high visibility, where you will collaborate closely with stakeholders, ensure smooth integrations and drive automation initiatives that add measurable value to the organization.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain ServiceNow solutions focused on Business Request Catalog and ticketing
* Build and optimize self\-service portal components, including custom widgets and forms for enhanced UX
* Develop reusable client\- and server\-side scripts (e.g., Script Includes, Business Rules, Client Scripts) for process automation
* Implement system integrations to streamline processes such as onboarding and service requests
* Prioritize out\-of\-the\-box functionality to deliver sustainable and upgrade\-friendly solutions
* Gather requirements, translate business needs into technical designs and produce fit\-for\-purpose implementations
* Ensure robust testing, documentation and deployment of all developments in agile iterations
* Troubleshoot system issues, perform root cause analysis and apply fixes across environments (DEV, UAT, PROD)

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in ServiceNow development
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript, Glide API and ServiceNow scripting
* Experience developing Service Portal elements, including custom widgets and front\-end enhancements
* Familiarity with REST web services, SOAP integrations and messaging frameworks (e.g., Kafka)
* Strong knowledge of ITIL\-based Incident, Request and Case Management modules
* Understanding of integration patterns (MID Server, API\-based) and data migration techniques
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) required; Application Developer or Implementation Specialist certification preferred
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues and ensure compliance with security and performance standards
* Excellent communication skills to engage both technical teams and non\-technical stakeholders
* Knowledge of security, compliance and governance standards in regulated industries

**Nice to have**

* Experience designing automation strategies and workflow engines
* Awareness of financial services IT operations and risk management requirements

**We offer**

* Private health insurance
* EPAM Employees Stock Purchase Plan
* 100% paid sick leave
* Referral Program
* Professional certification
* Language courses


EPAM is a leading digital transformation services and product engineering company with 61,700\+ EPAMers in 55\+ countries and regions. Since 1993, our multidisciplinary teams have been helping make the future real for our clients and communities around the world. In 2018, we opened an office in Spain that quickly grew to over 1,450 EPAMers distributed between the offices in Málaga, Madrid and Cáceres as well as remotely across the country. Here you will collaborate with multinational teams, contribute to numerous innovative projects, and have an opportunity to learn and grow continuously.




* **Why Join EPAM**
* **WORK AND LIFE BALANCE.** Enjoy more of your personal time with flexible work options, 24 working days of annual leave and paid time off for numerous public holidays.
* **CONTINUOUS LEARNING CULTURE.** Craft your personal Career Development Plan to align with your learning objectives. Take advantage of internal training, mentorship, sponsored certifications and LinkedIn courses.
* **CLEAR AND DIFFERENT CAREER PATHS.** Grow in engineering or managerial direction to become a People Manager, in\-depth technical specialist, Solution Architect, or Project/Delivery Manager.
* **STRONG PROFESSIONAL COMMUNITY.** Join a global EPAM community of highly skilled experts and connect with them to solve challenges, exchange ideas, share expertise and make friends.
jobs.tailored_advice: Since your match score is low, focus your CV on highlighting specific ServiceNow projects where you utilized Glide API and built custom Service Portal widgets. Emphasize your experience with ITIL processes and integrations (REST/SOAP), as these are core requirements. If you lack the CSA certification, highlight any ongoing preparation or equivalent technical expertise. Ensure your CV explicitly mentions 'upgrade-safe' development practices to align with their preference for out-of-the-box functionality.
