jobs.title: Customer Success - Southern Europe
jobs.description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**


This is a builder’s role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across Southern Europe, sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.


You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use\-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross\-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

 **What this looks like day to day**


You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.


You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross\-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue.

 **Requirements**

* 5\+ years of Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in the Southern Europe region
* Proven experience of owning and managing a defined Book of Business
* Fluent in Spanish and/or Italian (preference for both), and English
* Proven experience working across the Southern Europe market. Knowledge of the landscape and cultural nuances
* Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents
* Strong builder mindset \- you thrive in ambiguity and being a pioneer, finding ways to innovate across a full region or market to drive revenue outcomes
* Familiarity and experience with API Integrations, and comfort and knowledge of navigating SDKs
* Proven experience working cross functionally with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven experience driving revenue outcomes, including owning a revenue quota and identifying, qualifying, and closing cross\-sell opportunities along with renewals
* Excellent problem\-solving, technical, and analytical skills to address customer needs and concerns
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with customers at all levels of an organization
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently in a remote or distributed team environment

 **Location**


This role is remote\-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Spain or Italy. If you prefer, you can work from our office in Madrid or fully remote in Italy.


\#LI\-Remote


We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
jobs.tailored_advice: Highlight your technical proficiency with APIs and SDKs immediately in your summary, as this is a 'builder's role' rather than a traditional account management position. Emphasize specific metrics where you owned a revenue quota (NRR/GRR) in a B2B SaaS environment. Since ElevenLabs values a 'high-velocity' and 'AI-first' culture, showcase projects where you used AI tools to improve your own productivity or customer onboarding processes. Finally, explicitly mention your experience navigating the Southern European market landscape to demonstrate you can hit the ground running in that specific region.

jobs.title: PDP Designer
jobs.description:
### **About Social Scout**


Social Scout is a performance\-driven agency helping DTC eCommerce brands unlock maximum revenue through lifecycle marketing and web optimization. Having generated massive impact through email, we are expanding our core capabilities into Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and custom landing page design. We design, build, and optimize high\-converting digital experiences—from dedicated promotional landing pages to high\-impact Product Detail Pages (PDPs). Our work is data\-backed, visual, and strictly conversion\-focused.


We've partnered with 500\+ brands across a variety of industries, and we're growing fast. We're looking for a Landing Page \& PDP Designer who understands the intersection of stunning visual design, consumer psychology, and conversion\-focused UX.

### **Compensation \& Role Details**

* Salary: Highly competitive salary.
* Hours: Full\-time (40 hours per week) and fully remote.
* Engagement: You must be set up and hired as a contractor.
* Language: Fluent English required (written and spoken).
* Timezone: Available 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST
* Location: Full remote. You can be based anywhere in the world.

### **The Role**


As our Landing Page \& PDP Designer, you will be responsible for creating high\-converting, mobile\-first page designs and web assets across our client roster. You won't just be designing pretty interfaces; you'll be designing specifically to persuade users, solve UX friction, and drive add\-to\-carts and checkouts.


You'll work directly alongside our CRO Specialists, Account Executives, and developers. From mapping out custom PDP layouts and listicle pages to creating variation designs for A/B tests, your work will directly drive millions of dollars in DTC revenue.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* eCommerce UX/UI Design. You will design high\-converting PDPs, dedicated landing pages (advertorials, listicles, bundle builders), cart slides, and homepage variations for DTC brands on Shopify.
* A/B Test Asset Creation. You will design visual variations for active CRO experiments based on briefs provided by the CRO Specialist (e.g., redesigning sticky add\-to\-cart bars, value props, social proof blocks, and review sections).
* Figma Design Systems. You will build clean, responsive, component\-based design files in Figma, ensuring all assets are pixel\-perfect, mobile\-optimized, and ready for clean developer handoff.
* Conversion\-Driven Visuals. You will edit imagery, design custom badges, infographs, comparison tables, and visual hierarchy elements that clearly communicate product value propositions.
* Collaborative Design Reviews. You will present design concepts to internal teams and incorporate feedback from clients and strategists with speed and precision.
* Mobile\-First Thinking. You will design every layout mobile\-first, ensuring smooth user interactions and fast visual comprehension on smaller screens.

### **What You Bring**

* 2\+ years of experience designing for DTC eCommerce brands, specifically focusing on PDPs, landing pages, and web UX/UI (agency or freelance experience preferred).
* An exceptional portfolio showcasing conversion\-focused web design (PDP layouts, landing pages, and interactive UI components).
* Expert mastery of Figma (Auto Layout, Design Systems, Components, and Responsive Prototyping).
* Deep understanding of CRO best practices and direct\-response marketing design (e.g., visual hierarchy, visual social proof placement, above\-the\-fold optimization, and friction reduction).
* Strong understanding of web development constraints (Shopify Liquid, HTML/CSS). You know how to design elements that are realistic and cost\-effective to build.
* Basic video/GIF editing skills to create dynamic product showcase assets for landing pages is a major plus.

### **Why Social Scout?**

* Opportunities to shape the design standards of our expanding CRO department.
* Access to world\-class design frameworks, UI kits, and CRO research tools.
* A fast\-moving, supportive team with regular wins to celebrate.


If you're a conversion\-focused designer who loves combining high\-end design with direct\-response psychology, we'd love to see your portfolio and talk to you.
jobs.tailored_advice: To stand out for this role, your portfolio must prioritize conversion metrics over pure aesthetics. Clearly label your case studies with 'Before/After' results, specifically highlighting how your design changes improved Add-to-Cart rates or conversion percentages. Since they emphasize Shopify and developer handoff, include a section in your portfolio that shows your Figma files using Auto Layout and component-based systems, proving you understand the technical constraints of Liquid and HTML/CSS. Finally, emphasize your mobile-first design process, as this is a core requirement for their DTC clients.

jobs.title: CRO & Growth Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
============


Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer\-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about\-us/

**About the role**
==================


One of the RubyLabs’ portfolio projects is looking for a highly experienced and specialized **CRO \& Growth Manager** to join our team. The primary focus of this role is to drive top\-of\-funnel growth through optimizing our funnel stages, leading to user registration and payment. This role requires direct experience in managing and improving web funnels in **Igaming** projects.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Funnel Optimization:** Define and implement hypotheses to improve the conversion rate (CR) to purchase and lifetime value (LTV) within the web funnel.
* **Data\-Driven Strategy:** Dive deep into data on the competitive environment and user behavior to propose strategies that drive customer acquisition efficiency and improve CPA.
* **Testing Roadmap:** Run a robust testing roadmap, driving continuous improvement in the web funnel. You will ensure that strict quarterly KPIs are met and exceeded.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with designers, developers, and other key stakeholders to seamlessly execute optimization strategies, from product requirement documents to execution.
* **Ownership of Results:** Lead the entire growth process, taking full responsibility for results, from hypothesis creation to final implementation and evaluation.
* **UA Collaboration:** Work hand\-in\-hand with the User Acquisition (UA) team to build and optimize the full flow, ensuring that every step, from the first user interaction through registration and payment, is optimized for growth.
* **User Pain Points:** Deeply understand user pain points and behaviors, leveraging this understanding to determine the most effective strategies for selling our product.

**Qualifications**
==================

* **4\+ years** of proven experience with **web funnel optimization** in a B2C environment.
* **3 \+ years** of experience in the **online casino / iGaming space.**
* Ability to define, run, and analyze **A/B tests** specifically for web\-based funnels.
* Experience leading **growth initiatives** with a focus on **improving CR, LTV,** and other performance metrics.
* Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with **cross\-functional teams** including designers, developers, and data science teams.
* Ability to manage multiple growth initiatives and meet strict **quarterly KPIs**.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a **user\-first mindset**, aiming to understand pain points and optimize user experience.
* Experience in building and executing **strategic roadmaps** for growth testing.
* Familiarity with leading **agile software development** ceremonies is a plus.

**Location**
============


Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============


Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work\-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well\-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company\-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top\-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab\=t.0\#heading\=h.ndsdl4wapxtt


Be part of our fast\-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**
=====================


After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Take\-Home Assessment
* Technical Interview (45 minutes)
* Final Interview (30 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================


At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.


This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.


Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.


\#LI\-Remote
jobs.tailored_advice: Since you have a low match score, focus your CV on highlighting specific iGaming experience, as this is a non-negotiable requirement. Quantify your past A/B testing results by showing how you improved specific funnel metrics like CR or LTV. Use keywords like 'funnel optimization', 'user pain points', and 'KPI-driven' to align with their language. Since they emphasize a 'user-first mindset' and 'cross-functional collaboration', include a section or bullet points detailing how you worked with developers and designers to execute growth roadmaps.

jobs.title: Senior UX Writer (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
**Senior UX Writer (Maternity Cover) \- 6\-Month Fixed Term Contract \- Remote, UK Timezone**



DICE is a ticketing platform on a mission to get people out more. We give fans incredible live shows, upfront pricing every time, and tickets in a few taps.



We're looking for a UX writer to help create great experiences across our fan\-facing and partner\-facing tools. This is a 6\-month maternity cover, starting late August.



You'll join a motivated, talented team of product designers, our localisation lead, and another senior UX writer.


**More about what you'll do:**


* Write clear, concise copy across app, web, emails, and notifications for our fan\-facing and partner\-facing tools.
* Help make finding shows, buying tickets, and getting to the show feel effortless and fun for fans.
* Make building, managing, and analysing events on MIO a simple and delightful experience for partners.
* Write the occasional product mailer, CRM campaign, email, and help centre article.
* Inform UX decisions and design strategy from the beginning. We can promise you'll never be brought in at the end to 'add the copy' – you'll be working on the experience, hand in hand with designers, from the start.


* Work closely with lots of people across disciplines – designers, product managers, developers, data analysts, our localisation lead, customer support teams, and more.
* Present your work and ideas, clearly explaining the reasoning behind your decisions. This might be to peers, stakeholders, or business leaders. You'll always have support doing this if you need it.

**Useful experience and skills** for this role would be:


* Content design for app and web (B2B and/or B2C).
* Comfortable in Figma, the design tool we use.
* Writing in a particular brand voice, flexing that voice for different contexts.
* Working in a fast\-paced, fluid environment and across multiple teams.
* Presenting and defending writing and design.


**Diversity, equity and inclusion at DICE**



We know that having a variety of perspectives makes us a better company – it's why we strongly encourage members of underrepresented communities to apply. We aim to foster a culture where everyone feels that they belong, where our voices are heard and where we feel supported to be our authentic selves. See how we're creating a more diverse, equitable and inclusive DICE.


**Application process**



Our process usually involves a quick chat on the phone, a content design task, and an interview or two where you'll meet the people you'll work with. We'll keep you fully informed along the way.



For information on how we use your data, please view our Candidate Privacy Policy.
jobs.tailored_advice: Since your match score is low, focus your CV on demonstrating a strong UX writing portfolio specifically for B2B and B2C platforms. Highlight your proficiency in Figma by including a link to a case study where you collaborated directly with designers on wireframes. Emphasize your ability to adapt brand voice across different channels (app, web, email) and mention your experience working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams to align with DICE's collaborative culture.

jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Infatica.io** is a global provider of proxy and DaaS solutions. We're looking for a hands\-on Senior QA Engineer to work across two product lines: our web/SaaS product and our technology platform for scraping, data, and AI. The role combines manual testing, automation, and the development of engineering quality practices.


**Key Responsibilities:**

**Product Testing**

* Conduct functional, integration, regression, and smoke testing of web products.
* Test APIs, integrations, and microservice interactions.
* Create and maintain test cases, checklists, and regression suites.
* Write and maintain automated tests in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript.
* Integrate automated checks into the CI/CD pipeline.
* Collaborate with product managers, developers, and designers on implementation quality.

**Data, Scraping \& AI Product Testing**

* Test scraping processes, data pipelines, and distributed services in live environments.
* Test retries, rate limits, partial failures, degradation of external sources, and process recovery.
* Perform load and performance testing of critical services.
* Contribute to automated quality gates and quality metrics.
* Apply AI tools for test generation, log analysis, edge\-case discovery, and regression automation.

 **Requirements*** 6\+ years of experience in QA / Quality Engineering.
* Strong hands\-on manual testing experience with complex web and SaaS products.
* Test automation experience in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript.
* Solid understanding of API testing, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Experience with CI/CD and Docker.
* Experience with Grafana, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry, or similar observability tools.
* Performance testing experience.
* Comfort working with logs, metrics, and production incidents.

**Nice to Have**

* Understanding of HTTP, DNS, TLS, proxy networks, caching, queues, retries, and rate limiting.
* Experience testing scraping, data platform, or high\-load API products.
* Experience with Kubernetes.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Practical experience using AI in test automation.
* Experience with SLI/SLO.
* Experience testing AI functionality, eval pipelines, or golden datasets.

**What Matters for This Role**


We're looking for a self\-driven engineer who's equally comfortable testing a product by hand, writing automated tests, digging into architecture, logs, and pipelines, and systematically improving product quality — without moving into people management.

 **Benefits*** Remote work flexibility
* High autonomy in shaping testing processes and quality practices
* Work on both a SaaS product and a cutting\-edge scraping/data/AI platform
* Competitive compensation package

**Join Us**


If you enjoy owning quality end\-to\-end — from manual exploratory testing to automation and production diagnostics — and want to work across both a web/SaaS product and a high\-load data platform, we'd love to hear from you.

Highlight specific projects where you integrated automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Docker. Since this role values 'owning quality end-to-end,' emphasize your ability to perform both manual exploratory testing and technical performance testing using tools like Grafana or OpenTelemetry. If you have experience with AI-driven testing or testing data pipelines, move those to the top of your skills section to align with their specific needs for their scraping and AI product lines.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)**
======================================



Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today's hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:


* Predictable performance, even at scale
* Secure, compliant environments by default
* Real\-time observability and profiling built in
* Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
* AI\-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow\-the\-sun\-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.


Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.


What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.


Our values:



 We make a positive impact.



✨ We aim for the stars.



 We care for each other.


**Impact of an IT Systems Engineer**
====================================



As an IT Systems Engineer you take the identity plane from working to well\-run: automated, governed, and consistent, so access is correct by default, and our auditors find evidence rather than surprises. Reporting to the IT Director, you play a pivotal role in a growing internal IT department, driving the internal systems layer around identity—from our SaaS estate to Google Workspace.


You are the person who makes identity quietly reliable: predictable, documented, and automated, while remaining flexible enough to support the wider IT function as our scaling remote organization evolves.


**What to expect**
==================


* **Identity and access management:** Own Okta as the backbone of how people get access, managing the app catalog (SSO integrations for new SaaS tools), policy management (MFA, device trust), and directory hygiene (Universal Directory, group management, breakglass access). Run identity day to day, refine our SSO and SCIM integrations, and keep joiner, mover, and leaver flows accurate from our HR system.
* **Lifecycle and access automation:** Automate provisioning and deprovisioning so access is granted and revoked automatically, not by hand. Build and maintain workflows with tools like Okta Workflows and n8n, manage access configuration as code, and keep SCIM provisioning in sync with our HR system.
* **Process and governance:** Structure and harmonize clear procedures around the identity plane, so access requests, approvals, and reviews follow one consistent, documented path instead of ad hoc steps.
* **Internal IT systems and SaaS administration:** Own our internal systems end to end. Integrate, secure, and validate our SaaS stack, administer Google Workspace as our core collaboration suite, connect our tools through Okta and our HR system, and own the application validation process.
* **Compliance engineering:** Implement and evidence access controls for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 with our Security team, ensuring access reviews and audit logs are a by\-product of well\-built systems, not a quarterly scramble.
* **Endpoint and device management (shared):** Partner on administrating Jumpcloud our MDM across macOS, Windows, and Linux, sharing endpoint and device management with our IT Operations and Endpoint Manager so coverage scales with the team.
* **Where the team needs you:** We are a small, growing IT team, so scope will flex over time. You are happy to pick up adjacent systems work and support across the wider IT function as our needs evolve.

**What you bring**
==================


* **Identity expertise:** Deep, hands\-on experience with Okta or a comparable identity provider, including SSO, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and API\-driven provisioning
* **IT Experience:** Typically 5 or more years in IT systems, identity, or access engineering, including time in a developer\-heavy or engineering\-led environment.
* **Automation skills:** You build automation with tools like Okta Workflows, n8n, or similar, you are comfortable with APIs and webhooks, and you script in Python or a comparable language.
* **Process optimization:** You bring order to environments that grew quickly. You write clear procedures, standardize how things are done, and leave systems better documented than you found them.
* **SaaS\-first operations:** You have run and integrated a SaaS\-based environment, where identity and APIs matter more than racks and networks.
* **Compliance fluency:** You have worked inside ISO 27001 or SOC 2, ideally Type 2 where evidence is continuous, and you understand what auditors actually need.
* **Remote collaboration:** You work well without close supervision in a fully remote team, and you communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical colleagues alike
* **Google Workspace administration:** We are a Google shop, so hands\-on Google Workspace administration is core to this role: users, groups, policies, and security settings.
* **Working style:** You are comfortable wearing several hats in a small IT team, picking up adjacent systems and endpoint work, and flexing as priorities shift.

**Bonus points**
================


* Comfort managing configuration through Git\-based workflows, or infrastructure as code with Terraform.
* Professional proficiency in French.

**Where we hire**
=================



At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend \- it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in **Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom**. Although we're unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.


**How we hire**
===============



We know that a great hire won't meet every requirement that we've outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.


You can expect **4** interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you're looking for in your future working environment.



* 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition


* 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, IT)


* 60 Minutes with Team (Senior Director, Site Reliability Engineering \& Senior IT Manager)


* 45 Minutes with Executive (Senior Director, FP\&A \& IT)



*All roles require background checks.*


**What we offer**
=================



**A product you can believe in** \- Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud **B Corp**.


**An Award\-Winning Workplace** \- We've been recognized by Forbes' Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France's Best Workplaces for Women.



️ **A culture that values your voice** \- Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.



**A global team** \- Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives


**Benefits and perks** \- Make the most of what matters to you



 Flexible PTO



 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain)



 Company stock options



 Professional development budget



 Office equipment budget



‍️ Wellness budget



 Annual team gatherings



 Internet reimbursement



 Inclusive parental leave



✈️ Remote work travel program



**You belong here**
===================



At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.
jobs.tailored_advice: To stand out for this role, emphasize your experience with 'Identity as Code' and automation. Since Upsun values Git-based workflows and Terraform, highlight any projects where you managed SaaS configurations or IAM policies using version control. Clearly document your experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits, specifically focusing on how you automated evidence collection. Since they use n8n and Okta Workflows, provide concrete examples of how you have used these or similar tools to automate joiner/mover/leaver (JML) processes. Finally, since this is a remote-first, developer-heavy environment, frame your experience in terms of 'developer experience'—showing how your identity management work reduces friction for engineering teams.

jobs.title: Horizontal activities, tooling, documentation and support Architect, remote (EU) – MAIA
jobs.description:
**Horizontal activities, tooling, documentation and support Architect, remote (EU) – MAIA**

**Position:** Horizontal activities, tooling, documentation and support Architect.

**Location:** Remote (EU).

**Rate:** The rate offered depends on the candidate’s level, in accordance with the Commission’s public grading system and the ubication of the candidate. Further details are available upon discussion.

**Language:** Services will be provided in English. Consultants must have at least a C1 level, in accordance with the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).

**Minimum post\-secundary education required:** At least 5 years of studies attested by a diploma.

**Minimum professional experience required:** a minimum of 3 years postsecondary professional experience.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain back\-office tooling supporting business migrations, specifically for Grants and Experts domains.
* Deliver monitoring, testing and scripting tools to improve platform stability and operational efficiency.
* Support business developers in implementing Compass Corporate components within their processes.
* Produce and maintain up\-to\-date technical documentation.
* Provide 3rd\-level technical support and investigate complex technical issues.
* Perform migration, development, testing, maintenance and documentation activities.
* Analyze incidents, develop fixes and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
* Implement automation, performance optimization and technical remediation activities.
* Prepare deployment artefacts and support production integration activities.
* Participate in PI planning, sprint activities, technical refinement sessions and stakeholder demonstrations.
* Contribute to technical governance, coordination meetings and decision tracking.

**Specific knowledge, skills and expertise:**


Frontend development

* Proficiency in HTML5, Javascript/TypeScript, CSS3 and SASS.
* Proficiency in Angular, including modern concepts like Signals.
* Good knowledge of building complex, modular client\-side applications using modern. frameworks, Web Components, micro frontends and state management patterns.
* Experience in Web security, authentication and authorization protocols (OpenID Connect, JWT).
* Experience with responsive and adaptive design.
* Experience with leveraging Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) like AWS CloudFront to optimize asset delivery and improve application performance.
* Understanding key design principles.
* Understanding API integration patterns (consuming REST APIs, error handling, caching strategies).
* Experience with dynamic UI component integration patterns (loading, event communication).


Backend development

* Proficiency in back\-end languages (Java) and experience with frameworks (Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, Axon).
* Experience with legacy JEE application servers and technology standards and implementations (WebLogic 14, JAXRS, JAXWS, JAXB, EJB, JMS).
* Experience in designing, building, automating, and securing RESTful APIs and web services, including OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.
* Experience with API management technologies (Consul, API Gateways, CAPI Gateway)
* Knowledge of cloud services (e.g., AWS) and experience with deploying and managing applications in a cloud environment.
* Understanding authentication and authorization protocols and standards (e.g., OpenID Connect, JWT, Client/Server Certificate).
* Experience with leveraging AI agent technologies during development but also integrated with applications (MCP, Skills, AmazonQ/Kiro, Spec Driven development, context engineering).
* Experience with workflow engine integration (Activiti, Camunda).


Database \& Persistence

* Proficiency in working with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, Oracle, H2DB), including writing complex SQL queries and understanding database design.
* Experience with NoSQL document stores (ElasticSearch, Redis) and understanding of consistency/performance trade\-offs.


Architecture

* Experience with cloud\-native event\-driven micro\-service architecture principles and design patterns like CQRS, Saga’s.
* Experience with messaging solutions based on JMS and Kafka.
* Strong understanding of the web development cycle and programming techniques and tolos.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) for developing, deploying, monitoring and troubleshooting applications.


DevOps \& Infrastructure

* Experience with development and DevSecOps tooling, including version control (Git), Git workflows (GitFlow), and Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitLab).
* Experience with collaboration tools: issue tracking (Jira) and documentation (Confluence).
* Experience with Observability and Performance Monitoring tools (Dynatrace, Elastic APM, Grafana, Prometeus, Zipkin, LogStash, OpenSearch, OpenTelemetry).

jobs.title: Senior Python Developer
jobs.description:
Python developer with a strong passion for music?


That's what BMAT Music Innovators is looking for.


Even more so if you're based in Barcelona and enjoy the flexibility of remote work while having the option to meet your colleagues in person. However, being based anywhere in Spain or Italy is also perfectly fine.

**Experience with Python is required.** We're not looking for someone just starting out.


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a crucial role in BMAT, supporting a software team in achieving its objectives. Your contributions will directly influence/impact BMAT top of mind goals, making you an integral part of our team.

 *Recruitment agencies: we kindly request that you refrain from reaching out, as we are not seeking your services at this time. Thank you.*


Our stack* Backend: Python3 and Fast API
* Data Layer: PostgreSQL (via SQLAlchemy), MongoDB (via PyMongo), and Elasticsearch.
* DevOps \& CI/CD: Bitbucket Pipelines.
* Deployment: Containerised applications using Docker.
* Cloud: Infrastructure hosted on AWS.


Key Responsibilities* Take ownership of the technical design, implementation and deployment of complex features and system components.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
* Troubleshoot and debug applications to optimise performance and ensure reliability.
* Lead code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge.
* Stay up\-to\-date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the development process and methodologies.
* Contribute to break down high\-level architectural visions into actionable implementation plans
* Identify tasks while balancing system and infrastructure maintenance, migration costs, and their operational impact.
* Align software and systems to overall technical strategy, making tradeoffs where appropriate in consultation with other engineers.


Expectations of the role (ONLY FOR NEW POSITIONS)**Within 30 Days:**


During the first month, your primary focus will be on familiarizing yourself with essential aspects of the role, our core codebases, and systems context

**Onboarding and Training:**

* Complete the company’s onboarding program.
* Familiarize yourself with the company’s mission, values, and development process.
* Understand the tools, technologies, and frameworks used by the development team.

**Team Integration:**

* Meet team members and key stakeholders.
* Participate in team meetings and Agile ceremonies (e.g., daily stand\-ups, sprint planning).
* Start building relationships with your colleagues.

**Initial Contributions:**

* Review existing codebases and documentation.
* Pair with Tech Lead and other team members to understand our domain complexities and push your first production feature.

**Within 60 Days:**


By the second month, you'll be expected to take on more complex responsibilities and actively contribute to team/project/strategic initiatives.

**Active Participation:**

* Take independent ownership of complex tasks and feature implementations within the sprint. Lead internal technical design discussions for upcoming features, collaborating with the Tech Lead on system trade\-offs
* Lead code reviews for the team, providing constructive and high\-quality feedback to elevate overall code quality.
* Contribute to team discussions and planning sessions.

**Skill Development:**

* Continue to learn and adapt to the development environment and tools.
* Explore and identify opportunities for improvement within the codebase and offer expertise.

**Collaboration:**

* Work closely with other team members to understand project requirements and deliverables.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., QA, Product Management) to ensure seamless project execution.

**Within 90 Days:**


At the end of the probationary period, you'll be expected to autonomously manage tasks, contribute to technical planning, and take the lead of a complex delivery.

**Independent Contribution:**

* Demonstrate the ability to independently handle and complete assigned projects and tasks.
* Show proficiency in the primary technologies and frameworks used by the team.
* Deliver high\-quality, well\-documented, and tested code.

**Process Improvement:**

* Identify and suggest improvements to existing processes and workflows.
* Participate in retrospectives and provide constructive feedback to help the team improve.

**Establishing a Role:**

* Establish yourself as a reliable and integral part of the development team.
* Take ownership of specific components or features of the project.
* Proactively mentor and support junior/mid level team members, sharing expertise, knowledge and best practices.

  

**Requirements**  

* 5\+ years of proven experience as a Python Engineer delivering production ready features autonomously.
* Proven experience working with large datasets and handling large files at scale.
* Experience with asynchronous systems, batch processing, or event\-triggered workflows is a plus.
* Experience in Python.
* Experience with web development frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI) is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to effectively communicate with team members, stakeholders, and external partners.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and take initiative.
* Demonstrate adaptability and openness to feedback and learning opportunities.
* Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

Interview Process* Screening call with the People team
* Live Coding Challenges
* Interview with the team manager and part of the team to discuss the project

  

**Benefits**  

  

You Can Enjoy* Flexible working hours and location
* Flat hierarchy
* You can make the role your own and run your own development
* Online language classes to improve your Spanish or English
* Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts
* We’ll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable
* Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest.
* Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room https://www.bmat.com/bmat\-house/

  

Who the FAQ are BMAT
BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin\-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We’re now over 250 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, New Jersey, Oslo, LA, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos.


We’re a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We’re open\-minded and well\-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We’ve got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music and the excitement for innovative technology have proven to make a good combination.


BMAT has grown as a company of companies. Within BMAT there are a number of products and services that developed semi autonomously for different players – Digital Service Providers, Publishers and Collective Management Organisations.

*Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open\-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open\-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time\-zones \- but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work.*
jobs.tailored_advice: Highlight your experience with high-scale data processing and asynchronous workflows, as these are critical to BMAT's music data domain. Since they use FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and MongoDB, explicitly list projects where you optimized database queries or handled large datasets using these tools. Emphasize your leadership in code reviews and architectural decision-making to align with the 'Senior' expectations. Finally, mention any personal interest in music technology or audio engineering to show cultural fit.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
**About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)**
======================================



Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today's hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:


* Predictable performance, even at scale
* Secure, compliant environments by default
* Real\-time observability and profiling built in
* Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
* AI\-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow\-the\-sun\-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.


Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.


What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.


Our values:



 We make a positive impact.



✨ We aim for the stars.



 We care for each other.


**Impact of a Senior Legal Counsel**
====================================



As Senior Legal Counsel, you will serve as a practical, strategic, and collaborative partner working directly across our group companies with Product, Engineering, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Marketing teams. You will be deeply embedded in the product and sales lifecycles, building legal compliance into the core architecture of our platform, navigating emerging AI frameworks, and unblocking complex and bespoke commercial deals.


Your goal is to translate emerging regulations into clear, actionable business paths, and apply valuable legal expertise to the technical and commercial reality of how modern cloud applications are built and sold.



In this role you will be part of our Legal team and reporting to the General Counsel.


**What to expect**
==================


* **Embed compliance into the product lifecycle:** Partner directly with Product and Engineering to review new platform features and documentation, advise on open\-source software (OSS) and other vendor integrations, draft fit\-for\-purpose product terms and disclosures, and ensure continuous compliance with evolving technology sector laws.
* **Govern AI and emerging tech:** Formulate clear legal frameworks for features utilizing AI/ML models—focusing on training data provenance, output liabilities, and compliance with the EU AI Act. You will also help monitor legal and regulatory changes and develop internal policies for responsible AI deployment.
* **Manage infrastructure, vendor, and partner risk:** Review and negotiate complex upstream infrastructure contracts (IaaS), reseller agreements, EULAs, and AWS/Azure/GCP Marketplace agreements. You will also support broader corporate initiatives and help design and scale strategic partner programs.
* **Integrate data privacy and security:** Collaborate with our DPO, Senior Data Privacy Counsel, and Security team to map data flows and embed global privacy requirements directly into the cloud architecture.
* **Accelerate go\-to\-market and legal enablement:** Maintain and update customer\-facing terms (ToS, SLAs, Acceptable Use Policy) and act as a trusted advisor to global sales teams during complex and bespoke enterprise negotiations. To drive efficiency, you will develop legal playbooks, templates, and training compliance processes for internal stakeholders.

**What you bring**
==================


* **Legal qualification**: A Juris Doctor (JD, LLB, or equivalent) with active qualification to practice law in your jurisdiction.
* **Tech sector experience:** 5 to 10\+ years of post\-qualification experience within a law firm or in\-house legal department, specifically supporting SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or developer\-facing platforms.
* **Technical familiarity:** You do not need to write code, but you have a strong understanding of how cloud applications are built and deployed. You are comfortable discussing concepts like APIs, containerization, edge computing, merge/pull requests, and multi\-tenant databases.
* **Drafting and negotiating:** Experience drafting and negotiating all manner of contracts, including bespoke customer\-facing contracts, partnership agreements and product terms.
* **Language proficiency:** Highly proficient in both spoken and written English and French.
* **Execution and mindset:** A proactive problem\-solver with excellent communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills. You value clarity over complex legal language and thrive when working both autonomously and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

**Bonus points**
================


* A technical background, such as a degree or prior professional experience in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
* Specific prior in\-house experience working within IaaS or PaaS architectures.

**Where we hire**
=================



At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend \- it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in **France**, **Canada and Spain.** Although we're unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.


**How we hire**
===============



We know that a great hire won't meet every requirement that we've outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.


You can expect **4** interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you're looking for in your future working environment.



* 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition


* 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (General Counsel)


* 60 Minutes with Team (Senior Director, Professional Services \& Senior Legal Counsel)


* 45 Minutes with CFO



*All roles require background checks.*


**What we offer**
=================



**A product you can believe in** \- Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud **B Corp**.


**An Award\-Winning Workplace** \- We've been recognized by Forbes' Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France's Best Workplaces for Women.



️ **A culture that values your voice** \- Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.



**A global team** \- Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives


**Benefits and perks** \- Make the most of what matters to you



 Flexible PTO



 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)



 Company stock options



 Professional development budget



 Office equipment budget



‍️ Wellness budget



 Annual team gatherings



 Internet reimbursement



 Inclusive parental leave



✈️ Remote work travel program



**You belong here**
===================



At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.
jobs.tailored_advice: Highlight your specific experience with SaaS and cloud infrastructure contracts (IaaS/PaaS) in your summary. Since the role requires navigating the EU AI Act, explicitly mention any work you have done regarding AI governance, data provenance, or compliance frameworks. Emphasize your ability to translate complex technical concepts (APIs, containerization) into clear legal language for non-legal stakeholders. Given the requirement for French and English proficiency, ensure your CV is available in both languages or clearly states your fluency. Finally, showcase your experience in 'legal enablement' by mentioning any playbooks or templates you have created to streamline sales cycles.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Coverflex**
-------------

**Work changed. Pay didn’t.**


Coverflex exists to make compensation work for everyone.  

Pay is still rigid, fragmented, and hard to feel.  

We turn compensation into choice — one platform, one card, one app — for benefits, meal allowance, insurance and more.


Our platform is simple for HR and meaningful for employees.  

We provide choice, smarter compensation tools and empowerment.

**️ TL;DR (The Essentials)**
----------------------------

**Role:** Marketing Manager  

**Seniority Level:** Senior  

**Type:** Manager  

**Languages:** Spanish (native) \+ English (fully fluent)  

**Main Tools:** HubSpot, Webflow, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics / Looker Studio, Ahrefs / SEMrush / Google Search Console, Figma, Slack, Notion  

**Location:** Remote (Spain)  

**Compensation:**

* **Base Salary:** 34\.000€ \- 45\.000€
* **Equity:** Yes – Stock Options under our Equity Incentive Plan
* **Benefits:** You can check them below (at the end of the page)
* **Contract Type:** Permanent

**Your Impact**
---------------


Your role will play a major role in our success because Coverflex is still building its presence in Spain and needs someone who can own the full marketing engine — campaigns, SEO, content, events, social, and PR — while the Head of Marketing focuses on cross\-market strategy. You are not a pair of hands. You are the operational and strategic counterpart making things happen on the ground.


You'll know you're successful when, after 90 days, you've:

* Delivered the Q3–Q4 2026 marketing calendar on track (events, campaigns, content, SEO, social)
* Established a consistent SEO and content output pipeline with monthly targets hit
* Grown qualified inbound from Spain (MQLs) vs. the prior period
* Launched at least one PR or brand activation with measurable reach

**How we'll measure success:**

* Main KPI 1: % delivery rate of planned marketing calendar initiatives
* Main KPI 2: MQL volume QoQ and organic traffic growth
* Main KPI 3: Monthly content output (articles published, SEO briefs delivered)
* Secondary KPI 1: Event attendance and SQLs attributed to owned events
* Secondary KPI 2: PR coverage count and partner activations launched

**Reality Check \- What Makes This Role Hard**
----------------------------------------------


Let's be real \- here's what makes this role challenging:

* You'll need to hold two modes at once: strategic prioritisation and hands\-on execution, often on the same day. Neither can be dropped for the other
* Spain is a competitive market and Coverflex is still building brand awareness — results take time and require sustained effort before they compound. Patience and persistence are part of the job
* You're joining at peak season. September is the highest point of yearly seasonality in our market, which means you'll be onboarding, managing a junior, and delivering on one of the most demanding periods of the year — simultaneously, from day one
* For an initial period, the Head of Marketing will be absent. You'll need to hold the team together, make calls independently, and operate with high autonomy before you've fully found your feet
* Cross\-functional collaboration across teams, countries, and languages adds complexity — communication is part of the work, not background noise

**You**
-------

### **Must\-haves (evidence, not years)**

* You've owned a full marketing workstream — campaigns, SEO, events, content, social, PR — and can walk through how you planned, executed, and measured it end to end
* You write and edit fluently in both Spanish and English: you can draft copy, review a landing page, and present in front of an audience in either language without switching modes
* You've managed or mentored at least one junior team member and know how to give direction without micromanaging
* You've navigated a CMS (Webflow or equivalent) and published or updated content without always needing a developer
* You have at least 5 years in marketing management roles, ideally in B2B SaaS
* You can operate with high autonomy — you make decisions, move forward, and flag what matters without waiting to be told

### **Nice\-to\-have**

* You know the HR tech, benefits, or fintech space and understand the buyer behind those decisions
* You have PR contacts or a media network in Spain you can activate
* You've run B2B lifecycle marketing or lead gen funnels and understand the handoff to sales
* You have a public\-facing profile — speaker, webinar host, LinkedIn presence — and are comfortable being a face of the brand
* You have a portfolio or examples of previous campaign, content, or SEO work you can walk through

**Your DNA**
------------

* Strategic doer: you zoom out to set priorities and zoom in to execute them — often on the same day — without losing sight of either
* Proactive and ownership\-driven: you move without being asked, you document what you do, and you close the loop
* Editorially sharp: you have a feel for brand voice and catch things that are off — in copy, in design, in tone
* Calm under pressure: you don't lose rigor when things get busy, and you don't need calm conditions to produce good work
* Confident people leader: you bring structure and energy to a junior team member, not just a task list, and you're comfortable in front of people — at events, on webinars, in external partnerships

**You'll probably find this frustrating if…**

* You need direction or validation before you act — this role requires independent decision\-making from the start
* Strategy is your comfort zone and execution feels like someone else's job
* Pressure makes you cut corners on quality, consistency, or deadlines

**Manager \& Team**
-------------------

### **Meet Your Manager**

**Hiring Manager:** Ana Luna \- Head of Marketing Spain  

**Location:** Spain  

**LinkedIn Profile:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/analunamoya\-angeler/

**Profile Snapshot:**

* **Energy:** Energetic and passionate — puts real drive and emotion into everything she does
* **Communication:** Clear, direct, and empathetic — values context and transparency
* **Feedback Style:** Honest and constructive — gives feedback often, always oriented toward growth

**How to work with me \- in the Manager's own words:**


“Working with me means seeing marketing as a space for experimentation, creativity and analysis. I believe marketing is everywhere, and everything can become part of it when you understand people and connect the dots. I like structured work: documentation, organization and clear processes are key for me. I value teamwork, open communication and a human approach to everything we do. Marketing made by people, for people.”

### **Your Team**

**You’ll work day\-to\-day with:**

* **Sara Stucki**,Marketing Specialist, https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarastucki/
* Growth Manager and Growth Specialist
* Enablement team: design, development, and SEO\-web

**Key Stakeholders:**

* **Julia Abarca** **Muro**, General Manager Spain, https://www.linkedin.com/in/juliaabarcamuro/
* **Miguel Pinto Fraga**, Global Head of Marketing, https://www.linkedin.com/in/miguelptfraga/
* **Luis Rocha**, Chief Marketing Officer, https://www.linkedin.com/in/luisdarocha/

**Team Rituals:**

* a weekly meeting with the Spanish Team
* a weekly 1:1 with your manager
* a weekly meeting with the entire Marketing Global Team
* a Quarterly Business Review meeting for Marketing

**Access \& Belonging (Equal Opportunity)**
-------------------------------------------


We hire for **impact and potential, not pedigree.**  

We welcome applications from people with non\-linear careers, career breaks, caregiving gaps, and those changing fields.


No discrimination on the basis of **age, disability, gender identity/expression, marital or family status, pregnancy, neurodivergence, race/ethnicity, religion/belief, gender, sexual orientation**, or any other protected ground.

**Assessment fairness:**  

We anchor on *evidence of outcomes* (what you shipped, moved, or influenced).  

We actively de\-bias by using structured rubrics, multiple assessors, and blind screening most of the time (we won’t know your name, gender, or personal info until the interview stage).

**Application Clarity**
-----------------------


No cover letter required.  

Apply with your **LinkedIn** or upload your **CV**.  

You may be asked a few short, relevant questions.

**Total candidate time investment:** \~3,5 hours end\-to\-end.

**Hiring Stages (What to Expect, Why \& How Long)**
---------------------------------------------------

**1\. CV / LinkedIn Screen** — *Signal check vs must\-haves*  

* Done by People \+ Hiring Manager.
* You’ll hear from us within **7 business days.**
**2\. Role\-Fit Questionnaire (async)**  

Purpose: capture signals your CV can’t (languages, tools, scenario judgement) and calibrate seniority.  

Format: multiple choice \+ short answers.  

Accessibility: prefer a call? Tell us \- we’ll swap for a short chat.

**3\. Hiring Manager Interview** \- *Deep dive into your work • 45–60 min*  

Structured around outcomes, decisions, and collaboration.

**4\. People Interview** \- *Allow us to know you! • 30–45 min*  

With People. Stress\-free virtual coffee, focused on getting to know you as a person. We talk about culture, beliefs, and purpose.

**5\. Case Study** \- *Show how you think*  

Exercises that represent potential challenges this role would have and how you'd approach them.

**6\. Case Review \& Team Chat** \- *Walkthrough \+ Q\&A • 60 min*  

You’ll get actionable feedback either way.

**AI \& Hiring Tools Transparency**
-----------------------------------


We use a few tools to reduce bias and improve documentation, not to make hiring decisions.

* Teamtailor anonymisation: profiles are reviewed without relying on names/personal identifiers.
* Meeting recorder (e.g., Talka.ai): may be used to capture interviews so we can focus on the conversation.
* ChatGPT: may be used to turn interview notes/transcripts into clear, structured summaries.


Important: every application is reviewed by a human, and no decision or rejection is made by AI. If recording is used, we’ll be transparent and (where required) ask for consent.

**️ Speed \& Communication**
----------------------------

* **Decision:** within **4 weeks** of your application.
* **Updates:** weekly if the process runs longer.
* **Scheduling:** interviews between 10:00–16:00 CET (flexible across Europe).
* **Feedback:** from the Case stage onwards, you’ll always receive written or verbal feedback \- what went well, and what to strengthen next time.
jobs.tailored_advice: Since this is a 'strategic doer' role, your CV must highlight specific outcomes rather than just responsibilities. Use the STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result) to showcase how you managed full-funnel marketing campaigns. Explicitly mention your experience with Webflow and HubSpot, as these are critical for their operational workflow. Since they value 'evidence over years,' include a link to a portfolio or a case study document that details a campaign you led from conception to measurement. Finally, emphasize your experience mentoring junior staff, as you will be expected to manage a team member immediately upon joining.

jobs.title: Staff React/React Native Engineer
jobs.description:
**OUR MISSION IS TO ENABLE EVERYONE TO BUILD WEALTH**


We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.


Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.


Today, we serve over 6 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management, a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.


Our frontend spans iOS, Android, and Web — all powered by a shared **React Native monorepo.**


We offer remote or hybrid working, depending on role, with flexibility balanced against team performance and collaboration needs.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead the technical direction of a key frontend domain — spanning mobile and web — across the full product lifecycle, from shaping requirements through to delivery, monitoring and ownership.
* Drive the architecture of our frontend monorepo, making decisions that improve efficiency, performance and code reuse across iOS, Android, Web and Desktop.
* Lead a compact, autonomous, cross\-functional team with short release cycles. Identify and develop your teammates' strengths through active mentorship and coaching.
* Develop solutions by taking a holistic approach to problem\-solving — understanding business goals, UX constraints, platform limitations and the underlying architecture.
* Build for performance, accessibility and resilience — your code reaches millions of users and must perform reliably across a wide range of devices and conditions.
* Take the initiative to identify and drive improvements in product and engineering, raising the quality bar across the frontend organisation.

**What you need to have:**

* Experience leading the development and release of a complex, high\-demand client\-facing frontend product.
* Experience leading, coaching and mentoring software engineers toward delivering high\-quality software.
* Deep expertise in TypeScript and React Native (or React/Next.js).
* Advanced knowledge of state management patterns and solutions — TanStack Query, Zustand, Redux/RTK, or similar.
* Strong understanding of cross\-platform frontend issues such as performance optimisation, rendering, animations, and offline behaviour.
* Experience designing scalable frontend solutions.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with monorepo structures and shared component systems.
* Experience with native mobile development (Swift/Kotlin).
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling at scale.
* Experience with Reanimated/RNGH for complex animation and gesture handling.
* Experience with WebSockets or other real\-time data patterns.
* A strong product mindset that can seamlessly bridge the UX design with technical reality.

**What we offer:**

* Challenges that will help you grow and realise your potential.
* Opportunity to make a big impact — you will lead innovative engineering used by millions of investors to build wealth.
* Work with smart, spirited, helpful, high\-performing colleagues with a common goal.
* An environment where nothing is set in stone.
* Appreciation for your talent and ideas.
* Generous remuneration package including annual bonuses.
* Excellent social benefits package, including private health insurance and 25 days of paid vacation per year.

*All applicants will be contacted, regardless of whether they are selected!*


Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest\-growing mobile broker!
jobs.tailored_advice: Since this is a Staff-level role, your CV must shift from 'task execution' to 'architectural impact'. Highlight specific instances where you led technical strategy in a monorepo environment and quantify the performance improvements you drove. Emphasize your mentorship experience, as the role explicitly asks for coaching capabilities. Since they value a 'product mindset', include a section or bullet points detailing how your technical decisions directly influenced business KPIs or user retention. Finally, explicitly mention your experience with cross-platform performance optimization, as this is critical for their high-scale trading application.
