jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Lead
jobs.description:
**Talent Acquisition Lead – Spain**

**Spain \| Competitive salary and benefits**


TeamFeePay (TFP) is one of the biggest grassroots football club management platforms in the UK. Our ambition is a simple one: to be the number one platform supporting grassroots football in every market we operate in. We are a scale\-up growing rapidly across the UK and Europe and the people we hire and develop are what will determine how far and how fast we go.


We launched in Spain in early 2026 and already have more than 40 clubs on the platform as customers and, just as importantly, advocates for what we do. Having proven the market, we are now ready to accelerate. We expect Spain to follow the growth trajectory we have seen in the UK, where the team is now more than 100 people. That gives you a clear sense of the scale we are building towards, and of the pace at which hiring will need to move to get us there.


We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Lead, based in Spain, to take ownership of hiring in what will become one of our most important markets. Reporting to the Chief People Officer and with support from the Talent Acquisition Lead in Belfast, you will run recruitment end to end for every role we hire in country and support hiring into our wider European territories. This is a hands\-on, delivery\-focused role. You will own your own requisitions, source and assess candidates directly, and guide hiring managers through the process from briefing to offer.


This is a pivotal role and you will join at the start of a hugely exciting stage of our evolution in Spain. Every hire you make will shape how quickly we grow here, how well we serve Spanish clubs and the culture we build as the team expands. You will have considerable influence over our growth trajectory in Spain, direct access to leadership, and the chance to build a function from the ground up rather than inherit one already formed. Put simply, you will be integral to our success in this market.


As our first dedicated recruitment hire on the ground in Spain, you will be the local expert. You will bring the market knowledge, the language and the networks we need to build a credible employer brand in a market where we are not yet well known. You will not be doing it alone. Our Talent Acquisition Lead in the UK will help you get to grips with our hiring philosophy, our processes and our systems, and you will work closely with colleagues in Belfast so that our hiring standards are applied consistently wherever the role sits. You will be well supported to do the best work of your career here.

**What’s in it for you**

* Competitive salary and bonus
* Private medical insurance
* Professional development opportunities

**Your day\-to\-day**

***End\-to\-End Recruitment Delivery***

* Take full responsibility for all in\-country hiring in Spain, across every function, from individual specialist appointments through to volume commercial recruitment.
* Own a portfolio of live vacancies across Spain and, where required, other European territories, managing each one from briefing through to signed offer.
* Take detailed role briefs from hiring managers, agreeing the candidate profile, assessment approach, timeline and success measures before the role goes live.
* Write and localise job advertisements that are accurate, inclusive and appealing to candidates in the Spanish market.
* Screen applications, conduct first\-stage interviews and provide clear, evidence\-based shortlists with recommendations rather than long lists of CVs.
* Coordinate interviews and assessments across time zones, keeping the process moving and holding hiring managers to agreed timescales.
* Manage offer conversations, including salary discussions within agreed ranges, and work with the People team to get contracts and pre\-employment checks completed.
* Keep time to hire, cost per hire and offer acceptance within agreed targets, and flag early where a role is at risk of stalling.

***Sales Hiring and Assessment Centres***

* Lead recruitment for our Regional Football Representative (RFR) roles, which will make up much of the hiring plan through the initial phase of scaling in Spain.
* Plan and facilitate the assessment centres we hold in each region, covering candidate invitation and logistics, exercise delivery, scoring and calibration with hiring managers.
* Travel within Spain as required to run assessment centres and to be visible to candidates and hiring teams in the regions where we are growing.
* Build repeatable, high\-quality selection processes for volume commercial hiring, so that quality of hire holds up as the pace of recruitment increases.

***Direct Sourcing and Pipeline Building***

* Proactively source passive candidates through LinkedIn, local job boards, professional networks, communities and referrals, reducing our reliance on agency supply.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring and business\-critical roles so that we are not starting from zero each time a vacancy opens.
* Run targeted outreach campaigns in Spanish, with messaging that reflects TFP rather than generic recruiter templates.
* Develop relationships with universities, bootcamps, sector groups and local networks to build early\-career and specialist pipelines.
* Manage any agency or contractor relationships used in your market, holding suppliers to agreed terms, service levels and cost.

***Candidate and Hiring Manager Experience***

* Deliver a candidate experience that reflects our values, keeping every applicant informed and treating unsuccessful candidates as well as successful ones.
* Act as the main point of contact for candidates in your market, answering questions on the role, the company, the process and the practicalities of working for a UK\-headquartered business.
* Coach hiring managers on interviewing, structured assessment, note\-taking and fair selection, and challenge decisions that are not supported by evidence.
* Gather candidate and hiring manager feedback after each process and use it to improve how we hire.

***Local Market Knowledge and Compliance***

* Act as our source of local market intelligence, covering salary benchmarking, notice periods, hiring lead times, candidate expectations and competitor activity in Spain.
* Ensure hiring practice is compliant with Spanish employment law, including any collective agreement obligations that apply, and with right to work requirements.
* Handle candidate data in line with EU and UK GDPR, keeping records accurate, secure and retained only for as long as needed.
* Support safeguarding and pre\-employment screening requirements relevant to the grassroots sport sector.
* Work with the Chief People Officer and external advisers on employment model questions, such as direct entity or employer of record arrangements, feeding in what you see in the market.

***Employer Brand and Recruitment Marketing***

* Build TFP’s profile as an employer in Spain, adapting our employee value proposition so that it reads as locally credible rather than as a translated UK message.
* Create and localise careers content, employer profiles and candidate communications, working with Marketing to keep a consistent brand voice.
* Represent TFP at careers events, meet\-ups and industry gatherings in your market.

***Systems, Data and Reporting***

* Keep the applicant tracking system accurate and up to date, so that pipeline data can be relied on for reporting and forecasting.
* Report on recruitment activity and outcomes for your market, including pipeline health, source effectiveness, conversion rates and diversity data where lawful to collect.
* Identify where process, tooling or templates could be improved for multi\-country hiring and put forward practical suggestions.
* Embed equality, diversity and inclusion into day\-to\-day hiring practice, not just at the point of writing the advertisement.

**About The Role**

**You Should Apply If**

* You have solid experience as an in\-house or agency recruiter, with a track record of filling roles directly rather than relying on third parties.
* You are based in Spain and have recruited into the Spanish market, with an understanding of local candidate expectations, salary levels and hiring norms.
* You have a high standard of written and spoken English. English is the working language across TFP, and you will work daily with colleagues, hiring managers and leadership in the UK and Ireland, so you must be able to communicate, write and present in English with confidence and accuracy.
* You are fluent in Spanish, both written and spoken, and can source, advertise and interview credibly in the local market.
* You have experience in running assessment centres
* You are a genuinely strong sourcer who is comfortable building pipelines from scratch where the employer brand is not yet established.
* You have recruited across a range of functions, and are comfortable moving between commercial, operational and technical roles.
* You have recruited sales or commercial roles in the Spanish market. Much of the early hiring plan will be Regional Football Representative (RFR) roles, so experience of sales hiring across Spain will be particularly valuable.
* You are confident designing and facilitating assessment centres, and are willing to travel within Spain to run them.
* You are confident working with hiring managers at all levels, including influencing and challenging where the brief or the decision needs to be tested.
* You are organised and can manage multiple live vacancies without losing momentum or letting candidates go quiet.
* You are comfortable using data to report on your pipeline and to make the case for how a role should be approached.
* You have a working knowledge of Spanish employment and data protection requirements as they apply to recruitment, and the judgement to know when to seek specialist advice.
* You are comfortable working remotely and independently as part of a distributed, multi\-country team.
* You have a passion for the football industry and a genuine interest in grassroots sport.

**Desirable**

* Experience recruiting for a SaaS, technology or subscription business.
* Experience of being the first recruitment hire in a new market, or of supporting a market entry.
* Experience recruiting into other European markets, particularly Italy.
* Working knowledge of Italian or another European language.
* Experience with applicant tracking systems and modern sourcing tooling.
* A relevant recruitment or HR qualification, or equivalent experience.

*TeamFeePay is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, marital or civil partnership status, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will accommodate them.*

**Required Criteria**

 **Skills Needed**


Interviewing, Recruiting, Sourcing, Communication

**About The Company**


At TeamFeePay, we were founded with a clear mission — to make life easier for grassroots football clubs.


Established in 2018 and headquartered in Belfast, we’ve grown into a leading **club management and development platform** used by thousands of clubs across the UK, Ireland and Europe.


Our software enables clubs to automate **membership payments, player registrations, scheduling, safeguarding and communications**, while also supporting fundraising and long\-term development.


We go beyond technology by offering **club development expertise**, helping organisations improve governance, increase revenue and access funding opportunities.


As a fast\-growing scale\-up backed by investment, we are continuing to expand our reach — creating opportunities for ambitious people to join us on our journey.

**Company Culture**


Our culture is driven by a shared passion for **football, innovation and teamwork**.


We are a team of people who live and breathe the game — from coaches and players to developers and customer success specialists.


At TeamFeePay, we value **collaboration, creativity and ownership**, encouraging everyone to contribute ideas and take pride in their work.


As a growing tech company, we offer a dynamic and fast\-paced environment where individuals can make a real impact.


We support continuous learning and encourage our team to develop both professionally and personally, all while working towards a shared goal of **improving grassroots football**.

**Company Benefits**


We believe in building a workplace where people can grow, succeed and enjoy what they do.


At TeamFeePay, you’ll benefit from working in a **high\-growth tech environment**, with opportunities to develop your career as the company scales across the UK and Europe.


We offer exposure to a variety of roles and projects, allowing you to build skills across **technology, sport and business development**.


Our team benefits from a collaborative and supportive culture, where ideas are valued and contributions are recognised.


As part of a scaling business backed by investment, there are real opportunities for **career progression, learning and impact** — giving you the chance to shape both your future and the future of grassroots sport.


Retirement plan and/or pension, Free parking, Competitive salary, Wellbeing Scheme, Social Opportunities, Hybrid Working, Culture of recognition, On the job learning, Progression opportunities, Access to Health \& Wellbeing app, Staff celebration events

**Salary**


Not disclosed

jobs.title: FDE Subject Matter Expert (Part-time)
jobs.description:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort\-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

  

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: you would be part of a team of senior authors who help create the content for the course. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer *why* their approach is wrong.

 **Your audience:** Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward\-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client\-facing half of delivery.

 **Format:** asynchronous, estimated 20 hrs/week.

 **Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.**

  

Requirements:
  

* 7\+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer\-facing delivery).
* Has personally owned deployments end\-to\-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go\-live and adoption.
* Practical experience with databases and the infrastructure needed to run student projects (cloud environments, containers, version control, CI where relevant).
* Ability to break complex technical work into scoped, assessable tasks at a defined difficulty level.
* Strong written communication in English — you'll produce a lot of instructional text and it needs to be unambiguous.
* Comfort collaborating cross\-functionally with instructional design, and explaining technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience mentoring, teaching, tutoring, or reviewing others' code.

 **Preferred experience:**

* Prior EdTech or rubric/assessment design experience.

  

Brand:
  

TripleTen  

  

What you will do:
  

* Design and build the projects students work on end to end — scope, learning goals, technical infrastructure, environments, and supporting databases or datasets.
* Write clear submission guidelines and assessment criteria (rubrics) that reviewers can apply consistently
* Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to make projects and lessons educationally sound and engaging: refining wording, pacing, and difficulty calibration across the course.
* Research, evaluate, and sign off on technical solutions and tooling so the curriculum stays current and relevant to what employers actually use.
* Contribute to sales and marketing enablement — training commercial teams on what the course covers and what graduates can do.

  

What we can offer you:
  

* Fully remote work.
* A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
* Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
* A diverse, international, close\-knit team excited to work with you!

jobs.description:
J**oin our growing FinTech Engineering team! We're recruiting another Software Engineering Team Lead to join Asset Sales team.**

**The Impact**
--------------

Your architecture will directly shape how millions of people access credit for the first time. We've already served 10 million customers and unlocked more than $2 billion in credit since we began. Every system you design, every engineer you develop, and every decision you make contributes to a platform that's quite literally transforming financial inclusion across an entire continent


**The Opportunity**
-------------------


**Mission\-driven engineering:** Your daily work enables affordable smartphones, digital loans, and financial services for Africa's Every Day Earners — people for whom traditional finance simply doesn't work.


**Global recognition:** Join a FinTech company named by TIME 100 as one of the world's most influential and by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest\-growing company for five consecutive years (2022–2026\).


**Scale that matters:** You'll be architecting systems that process over 2 million payments daily across five markets — and building for the next 10 million customers.


**Environmental impact:** We're carbon\-negative, having avoided 2\.155 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions across our product portfolio.

**What You'll Do**


At M\-KOPA, you'll lead a team of backend engineers through both greenfield and legacy projects, owning the full software lifecycle from design ideation through to production and eventual decommissioning. Our engineering teams work under a true DevOps culture — with infrastructure as code, observability, automated testing, and continuous delivery treated as first\-order concerns, not afterthoughts.


You'll set architectural direction, partner closely with your Product Manager counterpart on roadmap planning and prioritisation, and serve as a servant leader who grows the people around you while shipping high\-quality, impactful software.

**Technical Environment**

* **Languages \& frameworks:** C\#/.NET
* **Cloud:** We work in Azure, and welcome experience across AWS or GCP
* **Architecture:** Event\-driven systems and microservice development \- we use Azure Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
* **Infrastructure:** Kubernetes, Docker
* **Observability:** Prometheus, Grafana
* **Engineering culture:** DevOps, infrastructure as code, automated testing across all environments including production, continuous delivery

**Our Engineering Approach**

* **Full ownership:** Teams own their solutions end\-to\-end \- from inception through production support to decommissioning.
* **Servant leadership:** We lead by coaching and enabling, not directing.
* **Quality by default:** Observability, monitoring, and automated testing are built in from day one.
* **Continuous improvement:** We foster a culture of innovation within a supportive, dynamic team environment.
* **Product partnership:** Engineering and Product work as genuine counterparts — planning together, prioritising together, delivering together.

**What You Need**


We're looking for an experienced, low\-ego engineering leader who brings both technical depth and a genuine passion for growing people.

**Required Experience:**

* Strong hands\-on background in C\#/.NET backend development
* Proven experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP \- we work in Azure but welcome experience across major cloud providers
* Solid understanding of event\-driven architecture and microservice development \- we use Azure Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers in a collaborative team environment
* Ability to set technical direction and provide architectural guidance
* Comfortable working with Product to shape roadmaps and drive delivery

**The Team**


You'll lead a close\-knit, focused engineering team with real end\-to\-end ownership over a significant part of the M\-KOPA platform. You'll have a dedicated Product Manager as your counterpart and operate with genuine autonomy over technical direction.

**Location \& Benefits**
------------------------

* Fully remote role in UK and parts of Europe within UTC \-1 to UTC \+3 time zones
* Work with diverse teams across the UK, Europe, and Africa
* Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships
* Family\-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
* Well\-being support and genuine career growth opportunities

**Our Mission**
---------------

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer\-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

**Our Impact**
--------------

Our technology has created measurable change:

* **Connected :** 2\.5 million first\-time smartphone users connected to the mobile internet
* **Prosperous :** 70% of customers use M\-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents
* **Green :** 2\.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided through clean energy and circular economy products, with over 127,700 circular economy products provided

**Ready to build the systems that create real\-world financial inclusion while leading a talented team of engineers? Apply Now!**

**Why M\-KOPA?**
----------------


At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritize well\-being, and embrace flexibility.


Join us in shaping the future of M\-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at **m\-kopa.com**.

*Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026\), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 \& 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e\-bikes financed in Kenya.*

***Important Notice***  

  

*M\-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

*M\-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M\-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.*

*M\-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre\-employment or post\-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.*

*Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.*

*If your application is successful M\-KOPA undertakes pre\-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.*

* You are fluent in English and Spanish, with additional language skills (such as French) considered a bonus.

### **What You'll Do**

* Analyze digital performance data using tools like Google Analytics,,Tableau, or plain old Excel to identify trends, user behavior insights, and growth opportunities.
* Develop comprehensive measurement strategies, define KPIs, set up tracking systems, and ensure accurate data collection for digital marketing initiatives.
* Build detailed reports and interactive dashboards that provide clients actionable insights on campaign performance and business impact.
* Oversee data integration projects, combining data from various sources (e.g., website analytics, CRM, and ad platforms) for a holistic view of marketing performance.
* Synthesize complex data into clear presentations, deliver strategic recommendations, and outline the next steps for clients based on analytical findings.
* Collaborate with marketing, content, and development teams to ensure data\-driven decision\-making supports overall business objectives.
* Conduct regular audits of analytics setups, troubleshoot issues, and implement best practices to ensure data quality and accuracy.
* Stay current with industry trends, tools, and emerging technologies to bring innovative analytics solutions to clients.
* Educate clients on key metrics, demonstrating the value of analytics and guiding them in leveraging data for strategic growth.

### **Perks \& Benefits**

* 15 observed holidays \+ 23 PTO days per year
* Indefinite contract following a trial period of 6 months
* Permanent remote work \+ work from home stipend
* Dedicated budget for professional development
* Compensated onsite retreats at our Bilbao HQ
* The opportunity to join a dynamic, close\-knit team that loves going to work with and for each other every day


Compensation is commensurate with experience and location, with opportunities for further growth.


**About Terra**
Terra is a digital marketing and creative agency built by an integrated and international team of content creators, strategists, designers, and developers. We help organizations reimagine and deliver their most ambitious digital projects and initiatives by acting as an extension of our clients’ teams and delivering exceptional online experiences, content, and marketing strategies.

Our team is innovative, tech\-forward, and creative by nature. We are dedicated to pushing boundaries and staying ahead of the curve in today’s ever\-evolving digital landscape. We believe in the power of collaboration and foster a work environment that encourages creativity and growth. And with a strong focus on work\-life balance, we prioritize the well\-being and career development of our team members. Finally, we are committed to promoting from within and offering meaningful opportunities for professional growth.

**Terra is also an equal opportunity employer.**

We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote team members regardless of their race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status (as required by applicable law).
Our top goal as an employer is to bring together a diverse mix of talented people who are excited to join our company, stay with Terra for a long time, and do their best work while they’re here. We take pride in the quality of the services and work we provide to our clients, and we know none of it is possible without the hard work and commitment of our passionate and creative employees.
